[**June 21, 1788:** New Hampshire ratified the United States Constitution during a convention held in Concord, New Hampshire. Its ratification was significant because it was the ninth state to approve the Constitution, reaching the required threshold for the Constitution to become effective and binding between those states. New Hampshire played a crucial role in the eventual establishment of the new federal government under the Constitution.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2feafe9a4d9b4bbb9deae6687dfe9c67&_e=5DEm204KnDR4Z907Mwj5TenXHjgEM5_JSUowKOIN3DCxg17JDy29kaiGSfqsh3uDR3MCCiezrTt_4M68v2u7alzMXHP5gLEiqw4Z8UHwys8LxXZlOn5axzJi0WRwC7AY9uirO0p5tnyIIjzr0sTbr2wuQGl2TnxShY2LUsUJSgvgBft0R4RNnRI5HpKXxyHdS_e9o79238hiovox8ixKRnXWRN7LFKj_NcHoWd8J6nMqoFQHqajvousYyEgVWfYl) **Source -[teachingamericanhistory.org](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=2feafe9a4d9b4bbb9deae6687dfe9c67&_e=5DEm204KnDR4Z907Mwj5TenXHjgEM5_JSUowKOIN3DCxg17JDy29kaiGSfqsh3uDR3MCCiezrTt_4M68v2u7alzMXHP5gLEiqw4Z8UHwys9GdLAuK14eSzBWJAdXLi88BGJmz3ueIzH07bOKJhPEFomJfdU3vAwZ69rXfpM8RJSFHO-ZhJDwaOm7pUyzjweoG-11gMM60RTvPcxwkQXjV-seBasvhj5JAv4TvRrDp4piQ5nn7ok8jFvz7POX1cvy)**

Derek,

I just left the House floor, where Kevin McCarthy took up the resolution
attacking me for holding Trump accountable.

After Trump threatened a primary challenge against any Republican who
refused to vote for it, MAGA Republicans officially passed their
resolution to censure me. Why? Because I upheld my oath of office and held
Donald Trump accountable for his many abuses of power.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1561?c0=jun2023_abs_em.ijd0au&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20230621_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=2638%2E5257348%2EIxU86I ]They will never silence me — not now and not ever — but I need your

campaign right now to help us respond to this unprecedented political
attack.

to health care, creating jobs, and so much more. Instead of addressing any
of these challenges, Kevin McCarthy chose to take up this MAGA effort to
distract from Donald Trump’s legal problems. They will never stop doing
his bidding.

Donald Trump.

vote to censure me, Trump is telling the entire Republican Party that they
must seek retribution against me politically and do whatever they can to
prevent me from being elected to the Senate. This is not just a political

holding Trump and his accomplices accountable or delivering real results

---
Our movement for fair maps helped secure what the _New York Times_ called “the fairest House map of the last 40 years.” And last November, we helped elect Democracy Defenders in key states across the country, and we helped defeat dangerous election deniers.

But now, Republicans are seeking to secure unearned power by:
* Manipulating maps and suppressing voting rights ahead of the 2024 election
* Attempting to stack state courts with judges who they believe will enable their anti-democratic schemes
* Asking courts to roll back decisions upholding fair maps and protecting voting rights
* Advancing a fringe legal theory that would give GOP legislatures unchecked power over federal elections
* ...and more

But we must remember that _we are not powerless_ against the GOP’s efforts to undermine our democracy. That’s why A.G. Holder also said **“We can and we are fighting back against cynical, partisan tactics like these. . . We need supporters like you to help us keep up the fight for fairness.”**

The NDRC counts on this grassroots team to power our democracy-saving work. We know not everyone can give every time we ask, but if even just one out of every four people reading this message pitches in, it will go a long way.

**Please, team: Will you be that one person?**

HB 3409 just passed the House, and as the end of session is just four days away, our state senators will vote on these bills any day now – possibly Thursday. [**Will you help make it across the finish line by writing to your state senator today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65197130/412631348/-1884238953?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA3OTc4OTUwLTkyMTAtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d1IWGM5fMft_MFdBKbs0SJJ7MNhGuRBjI-IdAE4-s2U=&emci=54e56f1c-8910-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=07978950-9210-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) The Climate Resilience Package includes two of our Priorities for a Healthy Oregon and offers bold, meaningful action. Cost-efficient heat pumps will be more accessible. Homes and buildings will be safer. Natural and working lands will be defined and protected for carbon sequestration. Our air will be cleaner. This is the future we all deserve. We cannot wait. [**Email your state senator now urging them to vote YES on the Climate Resilience Package (HB 3409 and HB 3630).**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65197131/412631349/-1884238953?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA3OTc4OTUwLTkyMTAtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d1IWGM5fMft_MFdBKbs0SJJ7MNhGuRBjI-IdAE4-s2U=&emci=54e56f1c-8910-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=07978950-9210-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) We need to keep Oregon families safe from extreme weather, create more family-wage jobs, and reduce rising energy costs. clean_body: | | | Dear Peter, Both bills in the Climate Resilience Package (HB 3409 and HB 3630) are headed to the Senate! HB 3409 just passed the House, and as the end of session is just four days away, our state senators will vote on these bills any day now – possibly Thursday. The Climate Resilience Package includes two of our Priorities for a Healthy Oregon and offers bold, meaningful action. Cost-efficient heat pumps will be more accessible. Homes and buildings will be safer. Natural and working lands will be defined and protected for carbon sequestration. Our air will be cleaner. This is the future we all deserve. We cannot wait. We need to keep Oregon families safe from extreme weather, create more family-wage jobs, and reduce rising energy costs. Thank you for all that you do. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

clean_body: We are campaigning in a different way than the other candidates. Soon, we'll be debating differently too. | | BIG NEWS: Thanks to you, Fellow American, I've met a major campaign milestone by garnering over 40,000 unique donors. That's enough to qualify for the GOP debate in August. I began this campaign with one vision: build the most successful grassroots campaign from the bottom-up. Even though we have hit the goal to ensure a spot at the debate, I want to make sure our vision for an American revival is front and center on the debate stage. | So what's next? I look forward to debating my Republican competitors and speaking hard truths. As I've said before, if you are afraid to take the debate,how are you going to take on Xi Jinping? This election is not about the "who" or cult of personalities, it will have to be about who has the best stance on the issues. Thanks, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. | Dear Fellow Patriot,

As you and I know – our freedoms are under attack.

They are under attack from our fellow citizens who see this country and her people as irredeemable.

They are under attack from leaders in government, media, and education who serve only one interest: their own interest.[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMTczLWJmZWFhOWYwNTNmZDQyZDM4OGFkMjM5YzIyNTA2MDc0IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL29mZmVycy5hbWVyaWNhbmNvcm5lcnN0b25lLm9yZy9zZXJ2YW50LWxlYWRlci1jYXJkLXBsZWRnZS8_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW1lbWJlcnNoaXBjYXJkX3BsZWRnZSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QUVfRkZPNDAzMDEmc291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUNJMjMwNUVQMDA1In0/raHr-aF7cyAGMAB0zGHIcQ)
These people hold the most dangerous, most extreme, most anti-American beliefs. They have taken more-and-more power away from the people... they are asserting more-and-more control over us.

They tax us, they regulate us, they silence us, they punish us, they remove opportunities from us, they weaken us, and they indoctrinate our children.

It is up to us to rise above as servant leaders committed to upholding the principles that inspired America.

We must set an example as faithful leaders and unite our fellow Americans in an effort to preserve our freedom.

We must be willing to sacrifice, to fight for our freedoms, to not just envision – but to ensure – a strong, prosperous, great America for our grandchildren.

Because if not us, then who will do it? Who will lead?

Today, I’m hoping that you’ll pledge your commitment as a servant leader for our great nation.

If you’re up to the challenge to help preserve our founding principles and lead our country in the direction of freedom, please sign the pledge via this secure link: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/servant-leader-card-pledge/](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTI2MDY0NDI4MiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMTczLWJmZWFhOWYwNTNmZDQyZDM4OGFkMjM5YzIyNTA2MDc0IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL29mZmVycy5hbWVyaWNhbmNvcm5lcnN0b25lLm9yZy9zZXJ2YW50LWxlYWRlci1jYXJkLXBsZWRnZS8_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW1lbWJlcnNoaXBjYXJkX3BsZWRnZSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QUVfRkZPNDAzMDEmc291cmNlX2NvZGU9QUNJMjMwNUVQMDA1In0/Xx9pCD6F3b1rWzWPJLWyBA)

It’s your sweat, your sacrifice, and your service to others, and to God that inspire me day after day. This effort will return our country to its beacon of hope and freedom.

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

name: Cherise Trump, Speech First
subject: Where free speech goes to die
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDAzMDQifQ/8lGJk7353m2XPVUJL0BBUg)
---
Friend, College campuses are where free speech goes to die. Across the country, at publicly funded colleges and universities, students' free speech rights are being banned, undermined, and chilled by progressive Administrators. Worse yet, your tax dollars are being used to brainwash an entire generation into believing a radical and toxic ideology. If you're anything like me, you're probably asking yourself, **_how is this legal in America? And why have we put up with it for so long?_** **Well, Speech First is ready to do something about it. We're gathering _THOUSANDS of_ signatures on our Open Letter to Congress, urging them to take urgent action to defend the free speech rights of millions of students nationwide.** [**Will you join the thousands who have already signed by adding your name right now?**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDAzMDQifQ/ENdE2ID2lh60N7bASy2G9Q)
---
[Sign the Open Letter](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDAzMDQifQ/Upb4nivzYAZNdHMwCcbZZw)
---
Across the country, colleges and universities receive millions of taxpayer dollars annually - and as such, they are duty-bound to the Constitution and to protecting, promoting, and teaching the First Amendment. But unfortunately, these publicly funded schools are using YOUR tax dollars to harass, embarrass, and silence students, especially conservatives, who hold opinions they consider "undesirable". That's why Speech First's Open Letter to Congress focuses on the most important policy areas impacting free speech for millions of students:
* Title IX "reform" -The Biden administration wants to change Title IX to be used as an anti-free-speech weapon by bureaucrats and higher education officials. Under the proposed rule, students could be forced to use gender pronouns they disagree with. While this issue lies in the hands of the Department of Education, Congress can still weigh in on Title IX through the Congressional review process.

* Bias Reporting Systems - Bias reporting systems (BRSs) unfairly target conservative students - and anyone else who does not follow the leftist ideology of bureaucrats and higher education officials.

* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI) programs - Despite their name, DEI programs, which cost millions each year, enforce an agenda driven by identity politics that can worsen divisions on campus, including the outrageous targeting of Jewish students.

And please understand, my friend -- these policies don't just impact the rights of college students. name: Melinda Shaw
subject: Thrown in jail for taking a criminal off the streets?
body:
My name is Melinda Shaw, and I’m the proud wife of Deputy Michael Shaw

| |
---
| | Dear Friend, My name is Melinda Shaw, and I’m the proud wife of Deputy Michael Shaw of the Bladen County Sheriff’s Office.
---
| | That’s Michael and me with our children in the picture I’ve included. **I know we've never met – but if you would move heaven and earth to protect your family, then I pray that you'll understand why I'm writing to you today.** As you may know, it’s a difficult and dangerous time to be in law enforcement. Officers across America have targets on their back just for wearing the uniform... it seems every time I read the news, another police officer has been gunned down during a routine traffic stop or ambushed during a call.
---
|
---
| | So, I knew full well the dangers of Michael’s job. We both did – though that never stopped me from worrying every time he left the house for work. I never imagined our worst nightmare would come at the hands of the local district attorney. You see, on October 8, 2021, Michael was involved in a **high-speed chase with a career criminal which resulted in Michael using minor – and necessary force – to apprehend the felon and now, my husband being charged with crimes that could put him in prison for many years... for doing his job.** It started when he made a traffic stop of a criminal named William Cain, a convicted felon whom Michael had arrested before. During the stop, Michael saw firearm ammunition in Cain’s glove compartment and that there were several missing rounds. As a convicted felon, Cain was prohibited from possessing ammunition – so naturally, Michael was concerned the suspect was also illegally carrying a firearm. Suddenly, Cain hit the gas and took off. Michael and his partner sprinted for their squad cars and followed. The criminal led them on a dangerous 11+-mile high-speed chase before crashing into a dark pond in a rural, unlit area. I’m thankful no one was hurt in the chase, but what came next is equally horrifying for my family. **You see, Michael and his partner apprehended Cain as he came up the bank of the pond and then tried to arrest him, but Cain decided to resist arrest while still near the bank of the water and a struggle ensued.** Finally, Michael and his partner were able to handcuff him at the edge of the pond after Michael was forced to use necessary strikes to subdue him. There was no serous injury, only lacerations. Cain was now in custody and the threat to Michael – and the community — was over. But three weeks later, the local prosecutor charged Michael with felony assault for that very minor use of necessary force. **If he’s found guilty, Michael could spend many years in prison. Locked away from our three children, Hunter (30), Anna Grace (24) and Harlie (13).** Friend, as a mother and the wife of a police officer, I’m used to planning for the worst. But I was in complete shock when we learned about the criminal charge. I used to imagine having to tell our children that daddy had been seriously injured and was in the hospital. Or that worse, he wasn't coming home. But how do you tell your children that daddy isn't coming home because our very own government is the one prosecuting him for doing his job? _My mind races at night thinking about what I will do if Michael is sent to prison.__ _ So right now, I'm trying to stay focused on the biggest problem we're facing: how are we going to pay for Michael's defense? Defending an officer in a case like this can cost hundreds of thousands of dollars. But raising three children on one police officer’s salary means we don't have that kind of money in our bank account. The answer to our prayers came when we received a call from Jason Johnson, President of Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF), who had heard about Michael's case. LELDF defends good officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. They have generously offered to help pay for Michael's legal defense. But first they have to raise money for a trial, which will require many dozens of hours of legal research, expert witnesses, legal motions and all sorts of advocacy efforts. To be honest, Friend, I’m not used to asking for help. But today I'm going to take a deep breath and ask you one of the hardest questions I've ever asked another person: [**Will you help LELDF fight for my husband by making a donation of any amount today?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zq32ia057cf9h4qvfjpotp22pkbka5q93mni6tp0_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5h61p71c9h2bs) Your gift is tax-deductible. And it will help us pay for Michael's trial and help other innocent law enforcement officers who've been unfairly charged, too. My friend, I know we've never met. But I hope you'll find it in your heart to help LELDF fight for my husband. [**Whether you can send $10 or $100, your contribution could be the difference**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsb2vkr0o0eftfinj7b9ohfacevmcnbdvvmm06h0_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5h61p71c9h2bs) between letting my husband rot in prison for ten years for a crime he didn't commit... or keeping him at home with his family where he belongs. After the hell we’ve been through, my family will be forever grateful for your contribution and support. People like you remind me that there is still good in this world. May God bless you.
---
| | Gratefully,
---
Melinda Shaw
---
P.S. My husband, Deputy Michael Shaw, is a decorated law enforcement officer who spent almost two decades defending our community against dangerous criminals. Now, our llocal prosecutor is threatening to put him in prison after Michael did what he was trained to do to apprehend a known felon. [**Please help LELDF fight for Michael’s freedom so he can continue fighting for the safety of our community and stay with his family where he belongs.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z9gn5nfgmg30ccj2g570hpshivd8hq8c34kmbn38_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5h61p71c9h2bs) Thank you in advance for your support.

We Can't Let Them
Get Away With This

We're challenging Tuesday's election results, but I need your help to do so.

During early voting we caught the Sturtevant campaign and Chesterfield GOP Chair red handed and have the documentation from the Chesterfield Registrar's office to prove it. We released this documentation in a press release on May 15 and have included it below.

State law says that if one campaign representative is present for the certification of early voting machines, then ALL campaigns must be invited to participate in the process. That's the law. And it was not followed.

Sturtevant lost Election Day voting by 2 percentage points.

Sturtevant only won by 346 votes, which were cast on uncertified voting machines. Those votes occurred on voting computers that were not properly certified according to Virginia state law. Any votes cast on these voting computers can and should be called into question.

When the violation occurred, the Chesterfield Registrar should have ceased voting on those voting computers certified and witnessed only by the Sturtevant Campaign Manager, and certified different voting machines by either allowing one neutral representative from both the Democrat Party and the Republican Party or allowing all campaigns to have a representative to ensure fairness and transparency.

But that didn't happen.
We're going to need help legally to fight this.

We're financially tapped out after 15 months of standing up to the Richmond Swamp who gave thousands to the Sturtevant campaign, spending 20 to 1 against our campaign.

Please make a donation today so that I can fight this.
We can't allow the political machine to put their thumb on the scale and get away with it.

You know I'm a fighter, but I can't do this alone.

Would you please invest $100, $250, $500 or your best donation today so I can bring on the best attorneys to hold these people accountable?

For God and Country,

**FROM THE DESK OF CONRAD BLACK** **You may already know that I spent most of my career in publishing and helped build the third largest newspaper company in the western world.**

We published over 400 titles, including the London Daily Telegraph, Chicago Sun Times, Jerusalem Post, Spectator, and most of the leading newspapers in Canada and Australia.

**I am proud to have also been one of the founders of the modern New York Sun, and believe that now, more than ever, it is a paper that is uniquely suited for this moment of crisis in journalism.**

Too many journalists are not only failing to live up to public expectations but are actively abusing public trust. Instead of policing the powerful on behalf of the public, they police the public on behalf of the powers they favor.

**The only one way the Sun can win is if we all join in its effort.** Collectively we cannot be overwhelmed by any media conglomerate or oppressive, woke, media groupthink. ## Math, Reading Scores Plunge
Test scores for American 13-year-olds [fell to their lowest level ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL_G3ojOBwZ7YOiSLV07Wmc4bCpsLECJ-vdVOnd8esvT-3osD4opntsnHWxbyAu5Fp-8gBaIAuWCvbeBGVn2bAc9GSVxxqHf7bCuuM5qJT2q4P0A2q8ggWjVk0OCPloElKARYR4lqptUs6MRjQ7GjKPTnQL2seVy-87xbDuH9JOfXG4uH32ye2tX7eRHh_cO73Sd_Kpv9YbSokvc4f2gtovC5OO5ica1iepy4SouOj0f0Ynq9pyTAIlMwRsPk0E0QeEEE4wYWCnjje6L9dcrphSrNp2C7aCY_kra_2N-AwAA__9uMGMP)in decades, with math scores plunging by the largest margin ever recorded in a national standardized test.

Covid lockdowns get much of the blame, but experts had expected a robust academic recovery by this time and not a continuing decline.

The problem has become a [political hot potato](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu6yAUgOGnwRsWPsfgMDBc6YotXaqqo0XgYFNhEwFKlLev2rnzv_z6Pq_r1aWczu3NHWR6LKvzPT1oFYoDcMAVhmAiERAOZCZ1WWYEDdOwGwlaB38JE9yim4JGcQtReimiUkojDsmAABQKQGiJMI84a-8kLCoui5ResVlQSL3U8auks-8U86s8qI6-HEM2e-_3xvAfA8vAups_6dnGrfxkBvbjnYE9XN95JRfSufHmS6XGA_mcTuIT8he5yksOjVe6l9oZ2NZLfTG0KTD8PwkB6gJSDdWE-zPlnJpa2Cy2w6X8-9H_ZvkOAAD__y12Yh0), with many Republicans blaming Democrats and teachers' unions for closing schools during the pandemic and Democrats blaming racism and inequality.
## FTC Sues Amazon Over Prime Trickery
The Federal**** Trade Commission sued Amazon for enrolling customers in its premium service, Prime, [without their consent](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOpDAQRL_GZEaeNtgQOLiEbC69EHnsZuhbg5HdM2j361dsvEmpglLp6f27z3dPifbnX7-h4yXPPjC9cVZGAkjQMzTRLYiAukF3M4PtNIxwa1bXa2_GwT-MHi0qG3EMqNTQBx0gmi425ECBVgZAjb2GrtXdGHwP1izW9n0wolMYiXNp_2faecUlfeY3ljbkrUluZT6q0H8ETAKm8zxbXvGN5YnXQMB03QuYzFVvV2hrBm1BwLRwkH7zX3mXyZ_1RSyPQhvK6MuHPDwzlr3K-nrUUOhgynttiovHSSlRNVZ06rl5Sj8s_Lua7wAAAP__Gf5jxQ) and making it difficult for them to cancel subscriptions without multiple "unnecessary" clicks.

The FTC suit claims Amazon built its web pages to trick customers into thinking they were clicking on a purchase or a free offer when actually they were subscribing to Prime.

Amazon Prime costs $139 a year and has [more than 200 million members](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu7CAURb8Gd1j48BoXFLdxN7dNaSE4zBDxsIAZK_n6yKlTb21prfVx3-82plge_21GM0LdrRvxjTtTFIAC32HyJiAC8gnNom5acFhhmZ5mZV4rQO4XJpRVzPvgcJU3KbnGm9BTNMCAMwXAVslBzFyszkrQKmgtpVNEMPRx1DZ_1ljGE0P6qm9ss6t5SuY5xtEJ_0dgI7Cd5zk3fA1s_doJbAkfNhHYbLbftVD_OtDTHFOKtXTqaumvjK3TWEalWFpNlyk9WsxIw3D0wqOX6UJgm5rxx3m9u9JEsEe2Mf2SjL_D_AQAAP__aZNkTA) worldwide. "The truth is that customers love Prime," the company said in response to the suit, claiming it makes sign-up "clear and simple."
## U.S. to Allow Sale of Lab-Grown Chicken
The U.S.** ** has approved for the first time the sale of [chicken grown in a lab ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u8yAUQJ_GbERw-R8YviVbvrWjdYHrhAqbyKax-vZVOnc8OsvR-bjNN6ytbvf_uFIcS58xj_qiWVgOwEHNwEpciIAUoyitd1pBAMkeMekCDkF4LYM0lHRJOQgqrljrTbasRhCghAUQwSjQF6VDRgPOLs4Zk-2kBZU6-n757HUbD1rad3_Rfsl9ZS0-xngek_o3wXWCKz43Oo-3esM-am40wTV_tVFfOKjwlXDwhonf935uPFNrPOFBhaP3mDwJ0NJJSEZIRBlkLmmxSQVkeyzPs7ZWD-smLe4r1vZbMf6e8hMAAP__ds1hhA)from animal cells, with no actual chickens involved.

Because the cost of growing the meat is so high, it won't appear in supermarkets any time soon. Instead, the companies have partnered with high-end restaurants to serve and demonstrate the product.

The product will be labeled as ["cell-cultivated chicken."](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu6yAYRp8Gb1j4B2N7YMgdvOVK7dLRIvCDaTFEmAT17at07vQNn3R0dD6u21WHGJL_rw9U1eVNmxqeuDFJASjwDTqrHCIg71ANcp4EhwWGble3Zbaaz0wMsOAgpZylnQ1H7cRNWiO7oIABZxKALSMH0XOxGD3CJN00jaORRDC0oebSf-aQ6o4ufucnlt7ko4tqr_V-En4hsBJYW2v9cabXR2DFRB8ngTVhe03LJVoCa9Q36ktuiZo9mC9M9EBdqcd6Ul8QE43B75W6kg_q0GLRkRb0j6hrLi-SLvRyGczbe_jXFWXvLcQYTjkRwfyhQ_x1q3-n-gkAAP__6X9rXg) The companies are touting it as a more environmentally safe way to produce meat, though at much higher prices.

FTC Sues Amazon Over Prime Trickery The Federal Trade Commission sued Amazon for enrolling customers in its premium service, Prime, and making it difficult for them to cancel subscriptions without multiple "unnecessary" clicks. The FTC suit claims Amazon built its web pages to trick customers into thinking they were clicking on a purchase or a free offer when actually they were subscribing to Prime. Amazon Prime costs $139 a year and has worldwide. "The truth is that customers love Prime," the company said in response to the suit, claiming it makes sign-up "clear and simple." We’ve set an urgent $4,600 goal to protect orcas and the planet: Donate $27 today!** _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836518?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836521?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
We have devastating news. **Beloved Southern Resident orcas Cappuccino, Marina, and Ripple have all died from starvation and pollution. And Big Oil and Big Shipping are about to make it worse. **
In the wake of their deaths, many in their families are starving, languishing, and growing weaker each day. But Big Oil and Big Shipping are at their doorstep, threatening to kick the door down. Their plans for a new shipping terminal and expanded oil pipeline could very well wipe out the last 73 Southern Resident orcas forever. [**Now is the time to act, while there are still orcas left to save. Don’t let Big Oil and Big Shipping push Southern Resident orcas to extinction and pollute the planet any longer: Donate $27 or more now and help us reach our $4,600 goal before we lose another precious orca.**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836522?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
Washington’s San Juan Islands are the traditional summer home for Southern Resident orcas. But this summer, we are seeing fewer of these native whales. Between 2004 and 2020 alone, there was a __75% drop in orca sightings in the area.__ Where have they gone?
To put it bluntly, Friend, **Southern Resident orcas are starving to death.** With their main food source -- Chinook salmon -- on the decline, their hunts are proving fruitless. Malnourished and grieving, two-thirds of pregnant orcas lose their babies before they’re even born. And Big Oil and shipping projects would drive away even more salmon from orca habitat. That’s why orcas need your help now more than ever. Please, will you be a voice for orcas and help stop Big Oil’s disastrous plans before it’s too late? The last 73 Southern Resident orcas and the planet are counting on you!
**Big Oil’s plans could be the final nail in the coffin for Southern Resident orcas. Protect orcas and the planet before the loss is too great: Rush your $27 contribution today! **
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836518?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836519?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836520?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836521?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Each death in the Southern Resident pods reduces the chances that the remaining orcas survive. Grief consumes the entire pod and can push them even further into starvation. With Marina’s death, her children are now three times more likely to die. What’s worse, her grandchildren are SIX TIMES less likely to survive.
The facts speak for themselves: Chinook salmon -- the main food source for Southern Resident orcas -- are declining rapidly. Chemical and noise pollution are harming the whales, too. Not to mention, the recent losses of three family members have shaken their pods and driven them further into starvation.
Southern Resident orcas are already facing a storm of stressors against them. We still have time to save them, but _**Big Oil has plans in the works that could push orcas past the point of no return. **_
The Roberts Bank T2 shipping terminal could bring starvation and death by driving away orcas’ scarce food supply, increasing the risk of a catastrophic oil spill in orca habitat, and disrupting whales’ sonar signals with underwater noise pollution. That means these weak, stressed, and grieving orcas will struggle even more to find food, locate each other and avoid dying outright in collisions with speeding ships!
Meanwhile, plans to EXPAND a major oil pipeline would inundate orcas’ delicate habitat with massive oil tankers. The expansion would send millions more barrels per day of dirty tar sands oil in tanker ships through their native waters. **That means it’s just a matter of time until the next oil spill could wipe out this orca family for good.** **But we can still fight back! **
**The time to fight back against Big Oil is NOW. Donate $27 now to help us hit our $4,600 goal for orcas and our planet. **
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836518?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836519?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836520?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1836521?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Big Oil and the shipping industry are risking the health of our orcas and our oceans for profit.** If we let them get away with their dirty dealings, you and I could be part of the last generation to share the planet with Southern Resident orcas.
Any orca death is devastating, but losing these precious whales could be more catastrophic than you think, Friend. __Orcas play an important role in keeping the planet healthy!__ They release vital nutrients for phytoplankton, which in turn provide half of the oxygen we breathe. But their impact doesn’t stop there. They absorb hundreds of thousands of tons of carbon each year. This promotes healthy ecosystems and a functioning planet. These are just a few reasons why we must protect these orcas at all costs.
The threatened Southern Resident population is _**just one major oil spill away from extinction.**_ And we know that oil spills are not a matter of “if” but rather “when.” That’s why we need to raise our voices and stand up to Big Oil and the shipping industry. We won’t allow them to put corporate profits over the lives of precious wildlife and the ecosystems that rely on them.
If you raise your voice now, we can still protect the last 73 Southern Resident orcas and stop these industrial megaprojects from destroying our oceans and our planet. **But orcas urgently need your help.** Your membership gift of $27 or more to Friends of the Earth today will allow us to fight these projects and the threats to orcas and our planet. Make your contribution now, while orcas still have a fighting chance, and we can stop these projects!
**Stand up to Big Oil and the shipping industry to protect endangered orcas and our planet. Donate $27 and help us reach our urgent $4,600 goal before the clock strikes midnight! **

What’s worse, her grandchildren are SIX TIMES less likely to survive. The facts speak for themselves: Chinook salmon -- the main food source for Southern Resident orcas -- are declining rapidly. Chemical and noise pollution are harming the whales, too. Not to mention, the recent losses of three family members have shaken their pods and driven them further into starvation. Southern Resident orcas are already facing a storm of stressors against them. We still have time to save them, but Big Oil has plans in the works that could push orcas past the point of no return. The Roberts Bank T2 shipping terminal could bring starvation and death by driving away orcas’ scarce food supply, increasing the risk of a catastrophic oil spill in orca habitat, and disrupting whales’ sonar signals with underwater noise pollution. That means these weak, stressed, and grieving orcas will struggle even more to find food, locate each other and avoid dying outright in collisions with speeding ships! Meanwhile, plans to EXPAND a major oil pipeline would inundate orcas’ delicate habitat with massive oil tankers. The expansion would send millions more barrels per day of dirty tar sands oil in tanker ships through their native waters. That means it’s just a matter of time until the next oil spill could wipe out this orca family for good. But we can still fight back! The time to fight back against Big Oil is NOW. Donate $27 now to help us hit our $4,600 goal for orcas and our planet. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: == == == == Big Oil and the shipping industry are risking the health of our orcas and our oceans for profit. If we let them get away with their dirty dealings, you and I could be part of the last generation to share the planet with Southern Resident orcas. Any orca death is devastating, but losing these precious whales could be more catastrophic than you think, Friend. Orcas play an important role in keeping the planet healthy! They release vital nutrients for phytoplankton, which in turn provide half of the oxygen we breathe. But their impact doesn’t stop there. They absorb hundreds of thousands of tons of carbon each year. This promotes healthy ecosystems and a functioning planet. These are just a few reasons why we must protect these orcas at all costs. The threatened Southern Resident population is just one major oil spill away from extinction. And we know that oil spills are not a matter of “if” but rather “when.” That’s why we need to raise our voices and stand up to Big Oil and the shipping industry. We won’t allow them to put corporate profits over the lives of precious wildlife and the ecosystems that rely on them. If you raise your voice now, we can still protect the last 73 Southern Resident orcas and stop these industrial megaprojects from destroying our oceans and our planet. But orcas urgently need your help. Your membership gift of $27 or more to Friends of the Earth today will allow us to fight these projects and the threats to orcas and our planet. Make your contribution now, while orcas still have a fighting chance, and we can stop these projects! Stand up to Big Oil and the shipping industry to protect endangered orcas and our planet. body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=2650%2E5257348%2EVXTQ3b ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,

I just left the House floor, where Kevin McCarthy took up the resolution
attacking me for holding Trump accountable.

After Trump threatened a primary challenge against any Republican who
refused to vote for it, MAGA Republicans officially passed their
resolution to censure me. Why? Because I upheld my oath of office and held
Donald Trump accountable for his many abuses of power.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1561?c0=jun2023_abs_em.ijd0au&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_NO_20230622_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=2650%2E5257348%2EVXTQ3b ]They will never silence me — not now and not ever — but I need your
help to fight back. If you can, rush an urgent $3 contribution to our
campaign right now to help us respond to this unprecedented political
attack.

We face many pressing challenges as a country — affordable housing, access
to health care, creating jobs, and so much more. Instead of addressing any
of these challenges, Kevin McCarthy chose to take up this MAGA effort to
distract from Donald Trump’s legal problems. They will never stop doing
his bidding.

We've already known that the GOP is completely unhinged and beholden to
Donald Trump.

With his call now to imprison me and primary any Republican who didn’t
vote to censure me, Trump is telling the entire Republican Party that they
must seek retribution against me politically and do whatever they can to
prevent me from being elected to the Senate. This is not just a political
stunt to rile up the MAGA base — it’s an attack on all accountability and
constitutional oversight.

But make no mistake: If they thought this was going to deter me from
holding Trump and his accomplices accountable or delivering real results
for California and our nation, they thought wrong. I will not stop my
fight to put truth and our democracy first — even if it means standing up
to a twice-impeached ex-president and his lackeys.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1561?c0=jun2023_abs_em.ijd0au&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_NO_20230622_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=2650%2E5257348%2EVXTQ3b ]Derek, with
Kevin McCarthy and MAGA Republicans ramping up their attacks against me,
I’m going to need you by my side more than ever. Will you add in a
grassroots donation of $3 to help me stand up to the GOP’s attacks and win
this Senate race?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1016?c0=jun2023_abs_em.5j4Bsc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_NO_20230622_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=2650%2E5257348%2EVXTQ3b ]EXPRESS DONATE $25

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1018?c0=jun2023_abs_em.9Bj7kB&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_NO_20230622_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1010&akid=2650%2E5257348%2EVXTQ3b ]EXPRESS DONATE $100

MAGA Republicans may have voted to censure me, but I will always use my
voice to hold them accountable. No matter what political retribution they

Let’s work together to push back against these attacks on our democracy.

Thank you,

Adam

Democratic Senate majority and the White House are on the line in 2024.

The future of our democracy and so many of our fundamental rights, from
voting to reproductive freedom, depend on Democrats winning.
Unfortunately, the 2024 Senate map strongly favors Republicans.

But here's the thing: Experts at CNN and FiveThirtyEight are calling Texas
our BEST pickup opportunity – and if we can flip this seat, Democrats are
virtually guaranteed to defend the Senate!

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zre9kuo00j8v8baibgbm7f7l7tur4cbtcq71fal8_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zh5ffj0abjtrsfequrvghaciahikta0qp9p2tpj0_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvi0et5dbfigojt3hc1u280h89a8gh0ig4k4qbh8_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhull80ajvjbfr0ubd72p00vur4kssp0qgoverh8_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zktbp7q8fmpc98qjt0mvp9nu8fhjpl9j4f7p4cuo_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvk1ki11kkt2trovlo3l60g6hco819brmaug2vbg_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2poh1m0oj5th8m7h4un0jv0jqispthbn3ca6abo_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjig59ih55smcd1v50n5cg00bc9jljlisfq4mo28_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgbimccugaotj37shug0j8k7c7me60gtr2qbtgp8_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5gm9or6c1h2bs)

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c26020%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tawsl%2fM%2b5NVyWYxnCagDVw&sysid=1)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c26021%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Lw2ob1YnxsDzBmZ4L7b%2fHg&sysid=1)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to \- is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c26022%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qlqJkEbC8yazQvFIBCljSw&sysid=1)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c26023%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=46nW3PkhoE1mCxrCsQ%2fCaA&sysid=1)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c26024%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T17oUJROy82%2bA3P8cC1Kiw&sysid=1)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. In every political campaign, there are things that we can control, and things that are beyond our control.
#

We measure everything in war.
The distance to the enemy. The distance to home. Our clothes are measured. Our boots. We measure the time before we leave, the time of patrols, the time until we return. We measure ourselves.
The one thing that we cannot measure is luck. But luck is the most important factor in war. All the other measurements can line up perfectly, and yet not guarantee success, or even survival.
In every political campaign, there are things that we can control, and things that are beyond our control.
Our job is to do our best at the things we can control, and when the unexpected happens, hopefully we'll be ready.
One thing we can control is whether or not we reach the fundraising goals we need to hit to win. And with our FEC deadline just 10 days away, we need to pick up the pace.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.
---

Peter,
In case you missed it at the last debate for the Nashville mayor’s race, I was the only candidate to offer up my personal cell number to the audience.
⬆️ Yes, you read that right.
That’s because I’m committed to Nashvillians first, not a billionaire’s agenda or the state’s hostile takeover of Music City.
Peter, I decided to run for this office because a mayor isn’t supposed to sell out to outside interests. A mayor is a public servant who works for each and every person in our community.
Peter, I have a deep-pocketed opponent who is scared because I can't be bought—neither can Nashville.
They’re scared because I put our community first, Peter. They’re scared because I'm looking out for our city and our best interests. They’re scared because I'm running a campaign based on integrity, experience, and coming together to improve our neighborhoods.
But I really need your help, Peter. It's going to take strong grassroots support to beat my opponents who don’t have Nashville’s best interests at heart. Can you chip in today to help me put Nashvillians first? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230622_em_fr_b1_HC_30_90_10_AllD]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230622_em_fr_b1_HC_30_90_10_AllD]
With gratitude,
Heidi [http://voteheidicampbell.com/policy-book]
Heidi Campbell is a Nashville native, Mom, former music industry executive and the first female mayor of the city of Oak Hill.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230622_em_fr_b1_HC_30_90_10_AllD [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230622_em_fr_b1_HC_30_90_10_AllD]
As mayor, Heidi established a track record for fiscal discipline, balancing the budget every year of her Mayorship, eliminating my own salary, and returning $2M to my city’s reserves.

| | Congressman Will Hurd here - America is ready for something different, but the choices we're given aren't different. _**Today, I am announcing my candidacy for president of the United States.**_ Common sense says we're better together. I know it. You know it. There's more that unites us than divides us. I've always kept my finger on the political pulse of America and I believe the Republican Party needs to look more like America. Diverse, eclectic, and open to new ideas. As a former CIA Intelligence Officer, Representative of the 23rd District in Texas, and a private sector cybersecurity executive - I believe in being actively engaged with the community. _And we can't be afraid of talking to those who disagree with us._

| | My friend, It's no secret or surprise that many universities around our country tend to lean more liberal. **What was a surprise, however, was learning that the University of Minnesota was offering an internship program that was only open to non-white students!** As an alumnus of the University of Minnesota, I was both frustrated and disappointed when I heard about this. Not only does this violate the Civil Rights Act of 1964 by discriminating based on race, but it fosters a divisive atmosphere on campus. [**Nobody should be excluded from academic opportunities because of their demographics.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=0a899ad0193f48d399298a3556652e7c&_m=6eafdfe6d46a4acc80010588babbc634&_e=l68Gyq_M14V7s7l7cQdlLxJk-y1MmT2_pKQFZQ3w7p4LvW8Ke1xtadh1vqwV4QPmzhgBvPiD3HcCwc2WG0xoyiwPRB3qsyv4psZRxOOqSf7n53n5Xmpnmyxz62ktis6WVfUrBGrctIsWfvqKYW2k9owrhYS2uXy2Xq9ExW2wcsYHFFfbJdVbZfSxoZDjAcx-QHZuwfAShdlOEC1m9Ic3-FOqaD5AFxzdC17QigqwDbouJk_49NGArPMvPoQ0LCLx) Luckily, after outside pressure, the University removed racial requirements for this internship, **but this should have never happened in the first place.** **Do you agree?[I'm looking for 1,000 concerned Americans to add their name to my petition and demand universities stop pushing woke racial policies on students:](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=0a899ad0193f48d399298a3556652e7c&_m=6eafdfe6d46a4acc80010588babbc634&_e=l68Gyq_M14V7s7l7cQdlLxJk-y1MmT2_pKQFZQ3w7p4LvW8Ke1xtadh1vqwV4QPmzhgBvPiD3HcCwc2WG0xoyiwPRB3qsyv4psZRxOOqSf7MPUMXeU8O8O_reSUL_Z87ryAgPHyLc8WwlMnS0XM805fSC0ZGwA1pSHBE1ejQhqcsb-V7uoKtohji7vTKDrYm_HLLAqPtBYXB05DRHSvXQrVD9LoYxcPDwk2Bgm6edu6osOrvI8ykJDKB8aN8c0P1)**

What was a surprise, however, was learning that the University of Minnesota was offering an internship program that was only open to non-white students! As an alumnus of the University of Minnesota, I was both frustrated and disappointed when I heard about this. Not only does this violate the Civil Rights Act of 1964 by discriminating based on race, but it fosters a divisive atmosphere on campus. Luckily, after outside pressure, the University removed racial requirements for this internship, but this should have never happened in the first place. Do you agree? Thank you,Brad Finstad | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---

subject: We’re Fighting Against Government Secrecy…and We’re Winning!
body:
The Left is trying to advance laws and programs that create discrimination in America

| | |

|

| Dear Fellow American,

Judicial Watch just struck another blow _for_ the American people's "right to know" and _against_ government secrecy, this time on behalf of a law-abiding Pennsylvania mother who dared to seek public documents and ask questions about _school shutdown policies_ during Covid.
We are America's largest "open records" litigator... _we file more lawsuits than anyone else_ to break through government secrecy and let the American people know what our government is doing!
_And we win_ ...but the costs are enormous and _we are fighting at all levels of government_.
**[That’s why I hope you will join us today and help us keep winning with a special tax-deductible gift!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63872&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63872&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

Here's what happened in Pennsylvania...

Back in early 2022, our client, Megan Brock, sent a request under Pennsylvania's "Right-To-Know" (RTK) law requesting correspondence between key Bucks County local government and school official related to Covid restrictions and the reopening of the county's schools.

After the county denied her request, Brock appealed to the Pennsylvania Office of Open Records, which ruled in her favor and _ordered_ the county to release the documents to her...

**... but instead of releasing the documents, _the county sued her_!**

_Talk about government arrogance and intimidation_!

Politics may have played a part, too, as Megan was a leader in fighting to re-open Bucks County schools during Covid, which was opposed by two Democratic commissioners (who may have overruled the county's own health director, a strong advocate for in-person learning), as well as the administration of Democratic Governor Tom Wolf, a strong proponent of restrictive Covid policies and one-size-fits-all school reopening policies.

Judicial Watch was proud to represent Megan in the two lawsuits she filed against the county, and on April 28th a Bucks County judge ruled that the county acted in "_bad faith_ " by withholding from our client records that are, by law, _public_.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63872&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

_The court ordered the release of those documents to Megan_ , and also ruled for the county to pay sanctions in the amount of $1,500 in each of the lawsuits (this is the highest amount allowed under the RTK).

Once again, the legal system and the courts worked!

These are _tremendous_ victories for the 'right to know' of parents and citizens. Indeed, the Court recognized the bad faith of the outrageous government lawsuits filed against our client!

You know probably know how successful Judicial Watch is are in suing the _federal_ government over its secrecy...but you may _not_ know how often we also are in courts across the country fighting for American citizens’ "right to know" against _state and local_ governments.

And fighting state and local government bureaucracies is just as time-consuming and costly as fighting the federal government!

(In fact, Bucks County is actually appealing the court decision that threw out its baseless lawsuits against Megan... _all levels of government_ have deep pockets when it comes to lawsuits!)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63872&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

And the fact is that government _at all levels_ is secretive, and government officials don't want to share information with us.

But fighting government secrecy is what Judicial Watch does better than anyone else...and that includes digging in and getting to the facts about government response to Covid!

That's why Judicial Watch successfully fought to release federal government records (_from both the Trump and Biden administrations_) about U.S. taxpayer funding of the Wuhan Institute of Virology in China, which recently revealed stunning information about how our support of this Chinese Communist facility may have directly supported the spread of Covid.

And it is why we were so proud to represent Megan Brock when she was being hounded by her county government for simply exercising her right to ask questions and see public documents to learn what her local government was doing when making critically important decisions about their public schools during the pandemic.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63872&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

Megan recently sent a note to our entire Judicial Watch team. I want to share with you something she wrote in it:

"_When the rule of law is not upheld, the dignity of human beings is destroyed ...it was clear that you are not only defending the rule of and the rights of citizens, you are truly fighting to preserve the human dignity of every American...Thank you for all the support you have given myself and my family. I pray that God continues to bless you in the good work you are doing!"_

I hope you will help us today so we can continue to so effectively use the courts and the legal system to fight for our right to know...and to fight for law-abiding citizens like Megan Brock!

I would be very grateful [you would join our Judicial Watch team with a special contribution today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63872&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWVGggzDNN

A movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWVGggzDNN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

I am
enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will
only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future.

A
movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.
In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as
devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's
why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on
Presidential Selection.

By
completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as
possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand
the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we
will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can
complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using
the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61949828:WVGggzDNN:m:3:2532013465:E666439EBDAC44A2D7A4C6730EB1BCDC:r

Do you
think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College
works and its role in preserving free and representative
government?
YES
NO

For most
of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the
Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it
was considered essential to preserving free and representative
government.

But
today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an
attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This
movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because
of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with
a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply
don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including
the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because
of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission
on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of
Americans in all 50 states.

These
efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of
our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online
courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide
with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets
popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding
documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and
guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of
charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including
American civics) to thousands of American educators and
homeschoolers.

Your
answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will
help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to
liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this
is especially important in this critical time for America's
future.

So please
share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National
Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon
as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can

From: **Chrissy Houlahan**
Date: Sat, Jun 17, 2023
Subject: Why this Pride month is so important >
| | |
---
Derek, this Pride Month is a time to honor the hard-won victories of the LGBTQ community, which continues to fight for the right to love and live as they would like to. **Today, this feels especially important, as our nation is embroiled in another ugly clash regarding gender norms, particularly as they relate to children, teachers, and the LGTBQ community. **
As you probably already know, my daughter, Molly, is gay. Last fall, she married the incredible woman who is now her wife, and the two began a life together. When I was elected to Congress, I made a promise to Molly to do everything in my power to protect and defend the LGBTQ community. It’s one of the reasons I helped the House pass the historic Equality Act to guarantee all LGBTQ Americans the full protection of federal civil rights laws. And it's why I won’t stop until the Equality Act is signed into law.
Amid these renewed attacks on the LGTBQ community, I ask my fellow parents, educators, and lawmakers to simply love one another and embrace our differences, regardless of gender identity, race, ethnicity, background, or sexual orientation. In a just America, love is love. That’s what I’m fighting for right now, Derek – I hope you’ll join me.
My family, and so many families across our great country, are stronger for it.

Happy Pride Month! There is work to be done.

Chrissy
