McCarthy's vengeful attacks on elected officials because Trump got his feelings hurt are pathetic.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=271%2E791427%2Ea8IhQw)
Friends —
Last night, Kevin McCarthy and the House GOP voted to officially censure Rep. Adam Schiff for leading the investigations that held Donald Trump accountable for his many, many crimes and abuses of power.
Let me be crystal clear:
**Kevin McCarthy is a spiteful coward who punishes _anyone_ that successfully exposes his weak leadership and stands up to Trump's lies.**
McCarthy has already made it obvious that I'm one of his top-priority targets in Congress this cycle. This is exactly the kind of spineless behavior that led him to kick me off the House Foreign Affairs Committee earlier this year.
The political attacks on anyone who challenges McCarthy and Trump's MAGA agenda are just beginning — which is why our movement needs to be ready for everything the right wing throws our way in the year ahead.

body:
We’re counting on grassroots supporters like you to step up.
#
Peter — our next big FEC fundraising deadline is one week from tomorrow.

# 🇺🇸 The Red Wave is Coming 🇺🇸
---
| This was a big week. On Tuesday, we flipped a Mayoral seat held by Democrats for over a decade in the Village of Port Jefferson. What's even more incredible is that a write-in candidate won! In spite of the Democrat's best efforts to keep her off the ballot, Mayor-Elect Lauren Sheprow and her grassroots campaign won. It's a testament to the people's voice being heard.
Remember last year? Democrats' Chuck Schumer, Kathy Hochul, and Letitia James all lost in Suffolk's Legislative District 5. Even bigger was that a 40-year entrenched Assemblyman was defeated in our community by Republican newcomer Ed Flood.
Change is in the air, and with your help we will paint this seat a blazing RED!
I am out there in the community knocking on doors and meeting the voters, but your support is crucial. The most precious commodity anyone can give is there time, and if you have any to spear our volunteers are knocking on doors with me this Saturday @ 10 a.m. leaving from 503 Main Street, Port Jefferson, NY.
If you're unable to join us physically, no worries! There are numerous ways you can still contribute to the help our campaign. We're currently fundraising for our mail program, a significant tool for spreading our message. Just one mailer comes with a hefty price tag of almost $15,000. Your generous contribution, no matter how big or small, will significantly propel us towards achieving our targets.
[Remember, our crucial filing deadline of July 15th is fast approaching! Whether you can chip in $50, $100, $500, or more - every bit helps in catapulting us closer to our goals. Your generosity will be the fuel that drives our victory march!](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016dSaD9MW_Qq_-G_QIt_4toYJpqz-uFKmeRHYB09jv3FquwffWEBQ0Uoq60A1oZK4bi7QlisFAvJB4VV0QCEGWRk4YpRS65fJoaEYPn3tONPKXPG0p8_GtIZs6whZXFGB3CaDfp4naKSg7vDuP4Lk5a-QxqW6E3mP-Ouobs6xkH3jvVcU0A67vmbB62iBe-0q&c=3RSkMmGu8YhSEtoVTFGoD46_O3v1WJmxWQD2V9IcAJ9jtIu_4xQo-A==&ch=WNB7yhXuZMY31qpOsobQ5hjZayUfNjttetWhr3EfZYkDmRoU2q6Rvg==)
Thank you for your thoughtful consideration in supporting our Families First movement.

Respectfully yours,

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1492d84b-1e16-4f17-9e1c-594da3514f50/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Happy Pride Month, Peter. I’m Will Rollins, a former federal prosecutor and gay Democrat running to flip California’s 41st Congressional District from red to blue. [In a moment, I’m going to ask you to split a $20 contribution between Blue Amp Action and our campaign to help us win this race and expand LGBTQ+ representation in Congress, but first I’ll explain why this particular seat is so important.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tde3afad8-2ea9-43e8-9b1f-1bf606ac3699/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) California’s 41st District is home to Palm Springs, and last fall, we made national headlines for going head-to-head in this district against a staunch opponent of LGTBQ+ rights, Ken Calvert. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdc076e16-7e3e-4cc5-a83a-bfcd8bf77c32/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) When it comes to LGBTQ issues, Calvert’s as bad as it gets:
* He opposed gay marriage.
* He voted against allowing gay adoptions.
* He voted down the Equality Act.
* He voted to allow employers to fire employees for being LGBTQ+.
* He voted against the repeal of “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell.”

And if all of that isn’t bad enough, his first electoral victory came in 1994 after he sent out bright pink mailers outing his then political opponent and accused him of harboring a “secret” homosexual agenda. Now Peter, the good news is Ken Calvert’s political career is more vulnerable than ever before. In 2022, I ran against him as a first-time candidate with 0% name ID, and we handed him the closest midterm election he’s ever faced (just 4 points!). National experts say that our campaign was the #3 over-performing Democratic challenger campaign in the nation. Now, in 2024, national Democrats are already calling our district one of 33 initial “offensive targets” to take back the House Majority. So let’s make a strong statement this Pride Month, Peter. Let’s send a staunch anti-LGBTQ+ Republican packing, flip this swing seat, and take back the House. [Split a contribution $20 or more between Blue Amp Action and our campaign if you’re with me »](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td6526b5e-bdc6-463a-bb8e-367a1cb8679c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for your support, Will Rollins

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! THIS SUNDAY, we are celebrating all that God has done over the last 3 years through the Let Us Worship movement!! And let me tell you, one night isn't enough!!

This is going to be a night to remember, and we want to put on a revival worthy of all He's done in the lives of thousands of Believers. This revival was born in California, and we're holding our 3-year anniversary in California. This means permits, regulations, and a host of financial challenges. We are 65% of the way toward meeting our need. If you would like to help contribute to the goal, please contribute below.

God has restored marriages, brought prodigals home, and emboldened Believers both young and old to toss off complacency and reject the lies of those who willfully tried to silence worship. We may be only three years in, but God's best is yet to come!

| | On June 12, I had the privilege of meeting with and addressing the great patriots who are a part of the Middle Peninsula Breakfast Club in Gloucester, Virginia. I am grateful for the strong support from members of the Club and from those who came from considerable distances across Virginia to meet with us there. On June 12, I also had the privilege of spending time with my good friends and Team Emord members, the Machens (George, Donna, Ruth and Peter), at their fantastic farm in North, Virginia.The Machen farm recently acquired several new goats, and they also keep a large number of very productive free-range chickens. They rely on organic farming techniques that keep their animals healthy and productive. The Machens are very generous people and filled our campaign vehicle with three dozen fresh eggs, goats milk, and delicious meals.
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| | On June 12, I had the privilege of addressing approximately one hundred members of the Virginia Beach GOP. I greatly appreciate the many Virginia Beach GOP members who endorsed our campaign at that event. On June 13, I joined approximately 100 Fairfax Republicans at a reception for Lt. Governor Winsome Sears. We made many great connections at the event and deeply appreciate the outpouring of support from Republicans in Fairfax.
---
| | | [**See our upcoming events here!**](https://www.emordforva.com/so/e7OZPv6Bh/c?w=E37X3nFvSOIbPP7EuuGTUX9V-uP1pz4rZQe97x1rnlI.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZW1vcmRmb3J2YS5jb20vZXZlbnRzIiwiciI6ImY1MzI1NDg4LTE2NmUtNGZmMi02MWE4LTFiYjM0YWNjNGM5MyIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjgxMDAxZWYyLTE4OTEtNDBmMC1iZjdkLWIyYTZjNmY1Y2VlMiJ9)
---
| | |
---
| | On June 14, I joined several leaders in law enforcement from the Williamsburg and James City County areas, along with a number of elected officials and local candidates who gathered at Sals by Victor for the Williamsburg Breakfast Club’s Law Enforcement Forum. I had the privilege of addressing the group on our Back the Blue Legislative Initiative, which is due to be published this coming week. I am very grateful for the overwhelming support shown to us from those in attendance. On June 15, I appeared as I do each Thursday on the Robert Scott Bell Show for an interview concerning all of the latest national and international developments. On June 15, I had the privilege of appearing as a guest speaker at the Fairfax GOP’s meeting at Fairfax High School in Fairfax, Virginia. We were overwhelmed by the generous welcome and support from those in attendance. At this event, we had the support of our newest campaign intern, Langley High School Junior Om Sharma. Thank you for joining Team Emord, Om!

Governor Winsome Sears in Arlington, Virginia; a presentation at the Williamsburg Breakfast Club’s Law Enforcement Forum; an interview on the Robert Scott Bell Show; and a presentation at the Fairfax GOP’s meeting in Fairfax, Virginia. | | | | | June 27 Rally!Newport News - Details Below | | | | | | | Date: Tuesday, Jun 27, 2023Time: 6 pm - 8:30 pmLocation: WOW Center 2 Facility, 525 Industrial Park Dr, Newport News, VA 23608 | | Straw Poll Results | | | | | | | | | | | | On June 12, I had the privilege of meeting with and addressing the great patriots who are a part of the Middle Peninsula Breakfast Club in Gloucester, Virginia. I am grateful for the strong support from members of the Club and from those who came from considerable distances across Virginia to meet with us there. On June 12, I also had the privilege of spending time with my good friends and Team Emord members, the Machens (George, Donna, Ruth and Peter), at their fantastic farm in North, Virginia.The Machen farm recently acquired several new goats, and they also keep a large number of very productive free-range chickens. They rely on organic farming techniques that keep their animals healthy and productive. The Machens are very generous people and filled our campaign vehicle with three dozen fresh eggs, goats milk, and delicious meals. | | | | | | | On June 12, I had the privilege of addressing approximately one hundred members of the Virginia Beach GOP. I greatly appreciate the many Virginia Beach GOP members who endorsed our campaign at that event. On June 13, I joined approximately 100 Fairfax Republicans at a reception for Lt. Governor Winsome Sears. We made many great connections at the event and deeply appreciate the outpouring of support from Republicans in Fairfax. | | | | | | | | On June 14, I joined several leaders in law enforcement from the Williamsburg and James City County areas, along with a number of elected officials and local candidates who gathered at Sals by Victor for the Williamsburg Breakfast Club’s Law Enforcement Forum. I had the privilege of addressing the group on our Back the Blue Legislative Initiative, which is due to be published this coming week. I am very grateful for the overwhelming support shown to us from those in attendance. On June 15, I appeared as I do each Thursday on the Robert Scott Bell Show for an interview concerning all of the latest national and international developments. On June 15, I had the privilege of appearing as a guest speaker at the Fairfax GOP’s meeting at Fairfax High School in Fairfax, Virginia. We were overwhelmed by the generous welcome and support from those in attendance. At this event, we had the support of our newest campaign intern, Langley High School Junior Om Sharma. Thank you for joining Team Emord, Om! | | See you on the campaign trail, Jonathan | | | | | | | | | | | | | PRESS RELEASE Veteran constitutional and administrative attorney Jonathan Emord announced today he is a candidate for the U.S. Senate in 2024. | | | Get our latest updates | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Share on social | | | | You've received this email because you are a subscriber of . Peter Willis, the fight
to end medical debt is heating up right now, and you can make an impact.

Our work to expose the role of hospitals in the medical debt crisis is
paying off! A recent New York Times story and a new report by Human Rights
Watch are opening many eyes to how “charity” hospitals are raking in
billions in tax breaks while failing to provide care to those who need it.

This is why we’re organizing patient activists from our membership ranks
all across the country to demand action from Congress and the White House
and call out hospital chains, credit card companies, and anyone who
profits from this sickness in our healthcare system.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8729?t=1011&akid=4390%2E5885482%2EO6O31u ]We’re coordinating inside and outside actions, investing our resources
in this winnable fight, but it costs money. We hope you’ll invest in our
patient advocates and their work as a team by setting up a recurring
monthly donation of $5, $10, or $27 ASAP.

Let me tell you about one of our patient activists: D’Anne M. of Arizona.
After beating cancer multiple times, D’Anne, 72, now lives with her
daughter after losing everything - including $250,000 she’d saved up for
retirement!

It’s okay to be angry. But more than getting mad, we need to get active.
Hospitals are price-gouging patients and deploying predatory collection
tactics. Many go broke, and others skip treatments that could cut short
their lives.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8729?t=1012&akid=4390%2E5885482%2EO6O31u ]D’Anne and our patient activists are not alone. Nearly 100 million

coalition if we all stand together. Pitch in a recurring donation today to

billions in profits, mostly from taxpayer dollars!

To recap: 339,000 jobs were created in May, and the unemployment rate remains low. **Here's a breakdown of the top six sectors that experienced growth in May.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65221749/412735678/-1599294071?refcode=2023-06-22-jobs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDQxOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTQ2NDM4Mi0xNzExLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o73SDDi94f7GHwvIE80M7MkRRnj8fW1dXnIImeLOE70=) Reports like these only tell part of the story, to get a better understanding of what we need to do next, we have to look at the broader economic picture. **Right now, that means considering inflation and what else could be keeping folks out of the workforce.** Inflation is hurting working families, we need to pass common sense legislation to bring prices down and wages up. We need to:
* address the supply chain issues that drive up costs by increasing American manufacturing;
* develop a container port in Coos Bay to create thousands of good-paying jobs, reduce shipping congestion, and give Oregon farmers and producers easy access to get their goods to market;
* lower energy costs while we transition to a clean energy economy; and
* expand workforce training opportunities so Oregon has the highly-skilled workforce we need to be competitive.

We need to make the workforce more hospitable by:
* increasing the federal minimum wage to $15/hour and eliminating the tipped minimum wage;
* reduce childcare costs through universal preschool and federal support;
* providing comprehensive paid family and medical leave for all workers;
* enforcing protections against discrimination and harassment in the workplace;
* making federal investments in workforce training and expanding the apprenticeship model; and
* passing the PRO Act to make it easier for workers to form unions and collectively bargain.

subject: Former Home Depot CEO issues dire warning for Americans
body:
Something strange is happening in our financial system.

| Dear Reader, Something strange is happening in our financial system. According to analysts at UBS, more than 50,000 retail locations could shut their doors in the months ahead. Already, Walmart, Foot Locker, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Macy’s are cutting stores. And former Home Depot CEO Bob Nardelli recently issued a grim warning:
> "We’re going to see a lot of bankruptcies. [This is] different than anything I have seen in my 52 years..."
What does it all mean for your family and your money? Dr. Nomi Prins has dug deeper into the research, and she’s found something startling. Amid all the turmoil predicted by Nardeni and UBS, Prins has found a single firm that could be the canary in the coal mine foreshadowing the next major crisis in America. All it takes is one look at this troubling chart to see why - [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrmaa0ud2k5ngnsj69u79qcje2gb05gl63ongri0_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5hm2p76c1h2bs) Dr. Prins says:
> ** "This chart tells you everything you need to know about the next crisis in America. In short, what we’re about to see is a currency crisis - but not the kind of currency crisis most folks expect. This firm - along with many others - will almost certainly go bankrupt as a result." **
According to Dr. Prins, our money is about to change forever... and the overhaul is set to happen in just a few weeks. To help folks prepare, she’s recorded a briefing that explains all the details of what she calls a 'reset' to our financial system. In it, she lays out all the evidence of this currency crisis, and what you can do to prepare. [Click here now to see her full (and free) presentation.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zob5aji549d9vkp0b7ivmgrl55610l719ujd54p8_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5hm2p76c1h2bs) Regards, Maria Bonaventura
Senior Managing Editor, Rogue Economics **P.S.** The last time we saw a similar transformations to our money, folks who failed to prepare were blindsided. But those who moved their money beforehand had the opportunity to multiply their nest-egg as a result. [Click here to see why.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqul43s8s2v8lg5tim5n705env1j0gkdu84j0a7g_rp22sh2s8i66o77c5hm2p76c1h2bs)

Peter,

I’m stepping away from calling supporters with my Campaign Manager for a moment to say how grateful I am for the support you’ve shown my campaign. We’re just over a month into our campaign to create life-saving change in TX-32 and beyond, and you’ve made it clear that I’m not in this alone.

Our communities are facing many issues that can be solved with bold, courageous action from our representatives in Washington. That means we need leaders who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby and will pass meaningful gun safety legislation to save more lives from being cut short by preventable violence. We need leaders who truly understand the barriers to healthcare that families face, whether it’s being able to afford care or simply having access to a doctor. And we need leaders who will always prioritize people over special interests and big money, and fight for a better future for our children.

I will be that leader in Congress.

My years of frontline experience have given me valuable firsthand knowledge of the most pressing problems people are facing each day. I’m running to make sure their voices are heard in the halls of Congress and to create solutions that are centered around people instead of politics.

[**I’m so thankful for the support you’ve shown so far, but I can’t win this race and be the fighter our families need in Congress without ongoing resources. If Republicans don’t win back control of the Senate in the 2024 election, it’s quite possible we will be locked out of the majority for the rest of this DECADE due to the Senate map in play.

It’s no exaggeration to say that this upcoming election will change the course of our nation - **which is why I entered this fight to take back the Senate.**

**If you have not heard from me, I am Jim Justice, the two-term West Virginia Governor challenging Democrat Joe Manchin for his current Senate seat.** I recently launched my campaign, and I’m looking for grassroots conservatives like yourself to join my team.

I’m under no illusions that you will invest in this fight the first time you hear from me, but **I’m willing to work for your support**. I hope once you see that winning my race is a critical component in securing a Republican Senate Majority, you will feel inclined to help.

_Take a look at the math, Fellow Conservative:_

Republicans are only TWO seats away from a Senate majority, and there are THREE Democrat incumbents up for re-election in ruby-red states. If we win in Montana, Ohio, and right here in West Virginia, we will win back the Republican majority in 2024.
_
**This West Virginia race is a TOP PRIORITY INVESTMENT for all conservatives, no matter where you live**_.

[** JOIN TEAM JUSTICE **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ef44fe6d4ec448bfa1d20226dcde9daa&_e=AYH_QLvlCx081gqr-NcWnLtMS_TfruWv76FcPs5QH7FICF9SJ6cA0Nu73p9KDfY0WHcp26VxbXeD789wCjsfLAqeLbSiPptsrxd6qsm9d9c-ee7LpVmqlCe7rX-zwsSMq-_9fj0VSJzIIjwuTL8IBNirAq9gV1wakB6q8N9kGX0KB7VI5DqBKVQq_iYe2VqsdShyHGYqyVJ6yx2oDBkhVRKsWTW_Ck0HjgcBAfsjC9CNGX5ebAg_iRUO4BxcKfsDa1QCIZPOnb7xXnZcoZBOO93sgjBuIRQDAI-qJ507owYuo3IZDYz-920PW-YelOHt1YXclZd0WvI5peaglTqZm1PQ-OVcVjVzJW2HKVRFpT_dgMS3DrwsBc9sxhksVHiwjUCRwjO4Xd2CU-Z2r3fJ1U8IaiyPfDrGEoISysqVYQGvUbmsZMVZnvXWv7Bjc2pc)

**My opponent is one of the most vulnerable Democrats in the Senate, with an abysmal 40% approval rating**. Plus, Republicans have won in six-straight presidential elections here in West Virginia!

Then this should be an easy win for Republicans here in 2024, right? **Not in the slightest,_Fellow Conservative_. **

Democrats like Joe Manchin have continually outraised Republican candidates in the past years, allowing him to win elections and hold on to this Senate seat. In 2018, Manchin won his race by three points, despite Republicans adding two seats to their majority at the time.

**Joe Manchin is sitting atop a $9.7 MILLION war chest, which he will use to buy this Senate seat, and with it, the Democrats’ Majority in 2024.**

**We won’t stand a chance of winning back our Senate majority if we can’t fight back against all this Democrat cash.**

I’m urgently calling for grassroots Republicans to **[join my team and pitch into our West Virginia Battle Fund today](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ef44fe6d4ec448bfa1d20226dcde9daa&_e=AYH_QLvlCx081gqr-NcWnLtMS_TfruWv76FcPs5QH7FICF9SJ6cA0Nu73p9KDfY0WHcp26VxbXeD789wCjsfLAqeLbSiPptsrxd6qsm9d9c-ee7LpVmqlCe7rX-zwsSMq-_9fj0VSJzIIjwuTL8IBNirAq9gV1wakB6q8N9kGX0KB7VI5DqBKVQq_iYe2VqsdShyHGYqyVJ6yx2oDBkhVRKsWTW_Ck0HjgcBAfsjC9CNGX5ebAg_iRUO4BxcKfsDa1QCIZPOnb7xXnZcoZBOO-8SkzsLzNMJvfR7haPpEwB_xgb4DONdJXUDC9NBj2z0wCy9i3TCk4xBDu4bWbmLfG22aQdmu7zY5c-Sgv4LGblq0ttQH2KDK5_RFzQXT-wPrZzYClJjF5x8cai5gh5EDntjaf2YwDF_uWrEc49Ot8Z2BVuJ4UYzqSLoDbr981Uz)**.

Gov. Jim Justice
Republican for U.S. Senate

| **MEET JIM**

Gov. Jim Justice is a conservative leader, successful businessman, high school basketball coach, and devoted family man. Before being elected, Gov. Justice led over 100 companies, creating thousands of jobs.

Gov. Justice has delivered on his promise of diversifying West Virginia's economy. He enacted the largest personal income tax cut in state history. He protects traditional values and has been recognized as a pro-life champion, signing more pro-life legislation into law than any governor in state history. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3280ab294c314ade80d2379252b14bd8&_e=9dvM1U_xSNEpuIfOIajxFNb55ZPEIihbsU2kGEgivfBZ7eyTTHyXaBZ1e3Vqg9YHuG6PM2riCAEVh114FIoIs35488z1imd1pkPpW1Rruqsj6abnh6HliBxvhpJNNYLKXvtwsU0PPXfGt_sq8KIXMmRnewNIbVWZaF45aZ71mMbt92IxM1k3NW4zJTend_CE9gqn-WOlyClmG6QTxDNTrQ_ZDRJeUFc4pQZ0Ut5HWR6QTw_t0Qbj1O6EwESaGuCgrT_ZpinWSJakCoDWFyrt7m6tikBby4-M1vMKfgCO24Q%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3280ab294c314ade80d2379252b14bd8&_e=9dvM1U_xSNEpuIfOIajxFNb55ZPEIihbsU2kGEgivfBZ7eyTTHyXaBZ1e3Vqg9YHuG6PM2riCAEVh114FIoIs35488z1imd1pkPpW1Rruqsj6abnh6HliBxvhpJNNYLKXvtwsU0PPXfGt_sq8KIXMvkNetND82JzRtyhJDoAdu4hieAUSUQFyAnMNFAA216NSN-yiHMn-t1qRnaL3DprXXMBjocXS6zeUgHQ738GzHYTwNI2LgDTPhYMgrBgxXVPoCuA8Ufpvd8407Itdw2AMGkubybBXDQ4cgqYyBlnHHU%3D)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3280ab294c314ade80d2379252b14bd8&_e=9dvM1U_xSNEpuIfOIajxFNb55ZPEIihbsU2kGEgivfBZ7eyTTHyXaBZ1e3Vqg9YHuG6PM2riCAEVh114FIoIs35488z1imd1pkPpW1Rruqsj6abnh6HliBxvhpJNNYLKXvtwsU0PPXfGt_sq8KIXMn5oTpbwQDTjqahdF9bhRpNuAJaqt_IDDp16NYo3IIQNs8x6rmczb8ShiMyLiGW_kUH9-Q48bywjpRVLnSeKzwWeNMPHtFt_8QmEAortscGZEsrBrGYtQ9MTBPxNAoaDG3vchEDot6ps2LEV2IzV1qc%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3280ab294c314ade80d2379252b14bd8&_e=9dvM1U_xSNEpuIfOIajxFNb55ZPEIihbsU2kGEgivfBZ7eyTTHyXaBZ1e3Vqg9YHuG6PM2riCAEVh114FIoIs35488z1imd1pkPpW1Rruqsj6abnh6HliBxvhpJNNYLKXvtwsU0PPXfGt_sq8KIXMhXIQ6N5ocG0h8GtQ_JadJ0OMTnKZVMDC29QvdWLcl37XXZea1jTC84GiiPb1D2F9FBkuZRThOMM_cIhj6lWjc9Eow2GaFCkj6WTy2DHyZh0FZVU7re2KUid_plhXC5g-fM-YJ7WkgsQRhu1h1VMrNg%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3280ab294c314ade80d2379252b14bd8&_e=9dvM1U_xSNEpuIfOIajxFNb55ZPEIihbsU2kGEgivfBZ7eyTTHyXaBZ1e3Vqg9YHuG6PM2riCAEVh114FIoIs35488z1imd1pkPpW1Rruqsj6abnh6HliBxvhpJNNYLKXvtwsU0PPXfGt_sq8KIXMnxi6niiY55k02-BlMnNojCEgb5SkYNYMfphMTr79-2C6UJ3eyzGTbMST8ia-s4lQYkod7r0IHptwYsE7dCjtjLhG7oH1dmGJW-okqQ26J_fijY5KtcPGeYLWD5ut0GyS5FDFKEvDvPh4Eh0NFEi0G8%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3280ab294c314ade80d2379252b14bd8&_e=9dvM1U_xSNEpuIfOIajxFNb55ZPEIihbsU2kGEgivfBZ7eyTTHyXaBZ1e3Vqg9YHuG6PM2riCAEVh114FIoIs35488z1imd1pkPpW1Rruqsj6abnh6HliBxvhpJNNYLKXvtwsU0PPXfGt_sq8KIXMhLG1u_YhOiZTPCU1XH43azXVjqFSuuqJYU6Zsj06MwSsEnnKGA5slyiVeVExh6Gm4uXlxwipViY8oEecNseavOAlbzvNUnMbMOAE2aWSI_9xCRX_RSC6AnLvANvoBBByWzyri0p0R06x4DyaTKvoRA%3D)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3280ab294c314ade80d2379252b14bd8&_e=9dvM1U_xSNEpuIfOIajxFNb55ZPEIihbsU2kGEgivfBZ7eyTTHyXaBZ1e3Vqg9YHuG6PM2riCAEVh114FIoIs35488z1imd1pkPpW1Rruqsj6abnh6HliBxvhpJNNYLKXvtwsU0PPXfGt_sq8KIXMkPFWruDhuqYNwpeMnKq2iLKSzLiHSW3WhHPh2V2JFkbvZ1Xj_ZQn3L6YCg99CK60p9j9u9OxxiHJRXG5twaWOGzhxoIlgaPvM62aNVl6eoDPKmIUt1_N-5lRI-k9MFkQOje1KMnuDtrlx_ixhYDM94%3D)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3280ab294c314ade80d2379252b14bd8&_e=9dvM1U_xSNEpuIfOIajxFNb55ZPEIihbsU2kGEgivfBZ7eyTTHyXaBZ1e3Vqg9YHuG6PM2riCAEVh114FIoIs35488z1imd1pkPpW1Rruqsj6abnh6HliBxvhpJNNYLKXvtwsU0PPXfGt_sq8KIXMkltP7BieM4H9J1_nWgVudTVBa8e7W5j2vQsx7m61FSF7Ph0UnMohn1vAKMhrig3sbqDa7MuLBtvYHmrMZWxjEHPXobbYqfsISwsY3M7BQIWUGkwx191pLqjFVoCg2eUbC6uU8yPxruL3lIsi4VkTTs%3D)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

clean_body: This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. # Philip Taub, M&A Partner at Nixon Peabody and Co-Founder, SWIM WITH A MISSION
---
In this episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Phil Taub, partner at the law firm of Nixon Peabody and co-founder, along with his wife Julie, of SWIM WITH A MISSION. Phil describes what it was like growing up in Africa, his first impressions of the United States, and how he ended up pursuing a career in law. He also shares lessons learned along the way to becoming one of New Hampshire's more influential civic leaders and one of America's leading mergers and acquisitions lawyers.
Tune in via the links below!

---
---
PRIOR EPISODES ALL AVAILABLE ON DEMAND!
For those who missed the prior episodes of NAVIGATING UNCERTAINTY, have no fear! They're all available on demand via the links below. As you sit in traffic during your weekend trips, tune in and use the opportunity to learn about some fascinating people as well as some of the most important topics of our times!
You'll find my conversations with Morgan Ortagus, Former Spokesperson for the State Department, David Jordan, Founder of Seven Hills Foundation, John Avlon, Senior Political Analyst at CNN, Derek Leathers, Chairman & CEO of Werner Enterprises, Rudy Glocker, Founder of Burgeon Outdoor, former US Senator Kelly Ayotte, NCUA Vice Chair Kyle Hauptman, Miami Mayor Francis Suarez, NH Governor Chris Sununu, NH Education Czar Frank Edelblut, Commissioner of Business and Economic Affairs Taylor Caswell, GOP Presidential Candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, former Commander of NORAD and Retired Four Star General Lori Robinson, and former Chair of House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence Mike Rogers.

| | | Friend,

I wanted to take a moment to bump Jim Jordan’s crucial message to the top of your inbox. House Democrats are doing everything they can to distract and delay House Republicans’ mission to get the American People **ANSWERS** on some of the most important issues facing our Nation.

If we lose our Majority, we will lose ANY ability to get that information AND root out corruption at the source. That is why we absolutely MUST hit all of our fundraising goals.

Take what he says to heart because the stakes are too high for you to ignore this message.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c669159%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=krq1fnC321BVZQ2Aa%2fpHNA&sysid=1 "I’ll let Jim take it from

Steve Scalise

This is Jim Jordan.

If you know anything about me, you know I don’t beat around the bush. If I’m worried about something, you’ll hear about it. Immediately.

So let me be 100% honest with you right now.

I just spoke with Majority Leader Steve Scalise and he told me we’re in quite a bind: **1)** _Inside Elections_ released their first set of House Ratings and they have us TIED with the Democrats for control of the House **2)** The latest FEC reports show Democrats OUTRAISED Republicans by $12,000,000+... **3)** _**[We still need fifteen-hundred strong Conservatives to make a small donation right away or our Republican Majority will be in SERIOUS JEOPARDY.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c669151%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uPE%2b9%2f9%2f2a8%2fpHDB6F%2fOUA&sysid=1 "We still need
fifteen-hundred strong Conservatives to make a small donation right away or our
Republican Majority will be in SERIOUS JEOPARDY.")**_
---
| | | [I’M PERSONALLY ASKING: CAN YOU HELP?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c669152%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sczxDdtw8QFLkhmm%2fjan1g&sysid=1 "I’M PERSONALLY ASKING: CAN YOU HELP?")
---
Listen, House Democrats exploited every ounce of their power to cover for Joe Biden and misled the public during every crisis they created together.

_If they outraise us and manage to destroy our Majority, the American People will never get ..._
* **ANSWERS** on Biden’s weak response to Chinese aggression
* **ANSWERS** on President Trump’s corrupt indictment
* **ANSWERS** on how Big Tech interfered with our elections
* **ANSWERS** on Democrats colluding with Big Tech to silence critics
* **ANSWERS** on Biden officials treating parents as domestic terrorists

The American People deserve answers, but getting them depends entirely on Republicans holding the House Majority. If we lose our Majority, we will lose all of the progress we made.

We need the support of our grassroots donors to prevail. **Without it, we might as well throw in the towel.**

_**[As I write this, we’re falling critically behind the Democrats’ fundraising efforts. I’m counting on you to make a small donation to help us catch up before our critical deadline.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c669153%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8DgrQyjV1frfuGrTVvRhZg&sysid=1 "As I write this, we’re
falling critically behind the Democrats’ fundraising efforts. I’m counting on you
to make a small donation to help us catch up before our critical deadline.")**_

Time is of the essence and I’m really counting on you.

For America,

Jim Jordan

Demonizing our fellow Californians isn’t the answer to fixing our state’s problems, but that seems to be Ron DeSantis’ only plan.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=25254%2E3422442%2E2rQF8r)
Derek,
Ron DeSantis was just in California fundraising for his presidential bid, and while in San Francisco, **he filmed a campaign video about the “riff-raff just running around” the city.**
Look, there are so many things our state has to be proud of. We’re protecting abortion rights, leading the transition to electric vehicles, and implementing gun violence prevention measures. We know there’s still ample work to do—that’s why Katie is running for the US Senate. She’ll fight to lower the cost of housing, take on big corporations, and protect our state’s vast natural resources.
**Demonizing our fellow Californians isn’t the answer to fixing our state’s problems, but that seems to be Ron DeSantis’ only plan.**
The Republican presidential process could stretch into March, making California’s March 5th primary decisive. This would seriously boost Republican turnout in our own Senate race. clean_body: Demonizing our fellow Californians isn’t the answer to fixing our state’s problems, but that seems to be Ron DeSantis’ only plan. Derek, Ron DeSantis was just in California fundraising for his presidential bid, and while in San Francisco, he filmed a campaign video about the “riff-raff just running around” the city. Look, there are so many things our state has to be proud of. We’re protecting abortion rights, leading the transition to electric vehicles, and implementing gun violence prevention measures. We know there’s still ample work to do—that’s why Katie is running for the US Senate. She’ll fight to lower the cost of housing, take on big corporations, and protect our state’s vast natural resources. Demonizing our fellow Californians isn’t the answer to fixing our state’s problems, but that seems to be Ron DeSantis’ only plan. The Republican presidential process could stretch into March, making California’s March 5th primary decisive. This would seriously boost Republican turnout in our own Senate race. Thanks, team. Katie Porter HQ Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma.

Support your candidate - add your vote to our poll!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

Hi friend,
Last week, Michael introduced a bill to permanently expand the Child Tax Credit (and Earned Income Tax Credit).
This is a policy he’s been fighting for since 2015. And it’s hard to overstate how beneficial it is: when the Child Tax Credit was expanded for just a year in 2021, it cut childhood poverty nearly in half and cut hunger in families with children by 25%.
This legislation will make a tangible difference in the lives of 65 million children. It’s exactly the sort of pragmatic, compassionate leadership Michael will always champion.
The expanded Child Tax Credit was passed in 2021 because Michael fought hard for it — and because Democrats had majorities in both the House and the Senate.
Taking back Congress in 2024 will be crucial to ensure we can keep fighting for policies like these.
Michael is working hard to elect Democrats in key swing states across the country. Will you chip in now to support him and his fight for our working families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_062223_CTCReup_act]
Thank you!
— Team Bennet

Friend,

I fought for years in Congress to get it passed. In 2021, we finally got it done, along with an expansion of Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC). These policies were an undeniable success:

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:

| Dear Kansan,

I was raised on Kansas conservative values, and I work tirelessly every day to defend them in Congress as I represent you. Over the past few weeks, I’ve been highlighting some of the ways that these values play themselves out in our country today. Here’s where the rubber meets to road:

**✓**** Freedom**

We need to secure the border, finish the wall, protect American farmers, ranchers, and producers from being taxed out of existence, block all forms of big government overreach, and stop land grabs. Freedom requires national security. _Border Security + Food Security = National Security_ , and President Biden is threatening all three.

**✓**** Faith**

For faith to blossom and flourish in our country, _we must remain a free country_. I introduced the More Accountability is Necessary Now (MANN) Acts – six pieces of legislation that push back on the Biden Administration’s overreaching executive orders relating to: _agriculture_ , _energy_ , _natural resources_ , _the right to life_ , _the Second Amendment_ , and _immigration_.

**✓**** Family**

I believe that _life begins at conception_. I support the _Parents Bill of Rights_ because parents have the right to know what their children are being taught in their schools. I also support the REIN IN Inflation Act. When President Biden took office, inflation was at just 1.4%. Inflation hit 6.4% in 2022. The _ANTI-LIFE POLICIES_ , _WOKE MADNESS_ , and _WASTEFUL SPENDING_ must stop now.

**✓**** Personal Responsibility **

Washington leftists think that it’s the federal government’s responsibility to make all your decisions for you. That’s why they want to dismantle the Second Amendment, crush American producers with new taxes, wage war on the oil & gas industry, take your private land for 30X30, block the WOTUS legislation, and add the lesser prairie-chicken to the endangered species list.

**_CONSERVATIVE KANSAS VALUES ARE UNDER ATTACK IN AMERICA_**

For too long, the federal government has been telling Americans to _sit down_ , _be quiet_ , _submit_ , and _be grateful that things aren’t worse_. I don’t serve in Congress to uphold those ideas. My message is this: **stand up** , **make your voice heard,** **exercise your freedoms, **and let’s **work together to make America stronger. **

**_Please support conservative Kansas values and join me in the fight to save America by making a contribution before June 30th. Whether it’s $25 or $13,200 (the max for a married couple) your support will help keep our country going in the right direction._**

You can ([Click Here](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=ad9e2daa13&e=a9d1410029)) or visit my website at [www.traceymann.com](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=0fd326db5d&e=a9d1410029) to learn more or contribute online.

I believe with hard work and prayer our brightest days are yet to come! Thank you for your support – I could not do this without your help.

In the Fight,
Tracey Mann

P.S. I stand for Kansas, and I always will. I promise that I will do everything within my power to ensure that our kids have a bright future. Please donate today and help take our country back.

body:
This month, we are proud to honor 12-year old Baxter Whitworth. | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
# Welcome to the June edition of **The Moran Minuteman**.
This monthly newsletter is our way of recognizing extraordinary efforts in Texas Congressional District 1 and providing an inside look into what happens behind the scenes in the life of a Congressman.
---
|
---
| Earlier this month, we celebrated America’s pastime and raised funds for organizations that serve vulnerable children and families with the Congressional Baseball Game.

The Congressional Baseball game started in 1909. It is an annual bi-partisan event where Republicans battle Democrats on the baseball diamond. I am proud to report that the Republicans won by a landslide - 16 to 6! This is the third victory in a row for the Red team. More importantly, together, we raised $1.8 million for charity. Congratulations to everyone who participated!
---
|
---
---
|
---
|
## Congratulations to our June Minuteman -
When I think of East Texans, I think of the [Minutemen of the Revolutionary War](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=e17b6c9edc&e=bbce4dd6ad). Loyal to country and community, dependable, selfless, and ready at a moment’s notice, the Minutemen were American heroes who helped turn the tide of the Revolutionary War. **Today’s East Texans reflect those traits.** You are patriotic, dependable, and deeply committed to making our communities better.

Each month, I will recognize an East Texan who has gone above and beyond in serving our region - someone who epitomizes the identity of a Minuteman. In addition to recognition in the monthly newsletter, we will send the person a Moran Minuteman t-shirt.

This month’s Minuteman, 12-year-old Baxter Whitworth, embodies the entrepreneurial American spirit. When he was just 10 years old, Baxter told his dad, the owner/operator of a large commercial cow-calf operation, that he wanted to create a cattle company. When his dad responded that they already had one, Baxter said, “No, that belongs to you and mom. I want to start a business of my own.”
---
|
---
| Building on a passion for Brahman cattle, Baxter researched the breed, purchased a bull, and founded Top Notch Cattle Company, devising the name and brand all by himself. After winning Division Champion at the State Brahman show, Baxter has been marketing his bull to breed and reinvesting the profits into his business. His goal is to build the cattle operation over the next several years so it will provide his livelihood after he graduates from college.

Thank you, Baxter, for being an example to all of us by showing us that through hard work and dedication, anyone can achieve the American dream!

Do you know an East Texan who would be a great next recipient? Please submit their name **[here](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=2c649d3fea&e=bbce4dd6ad).**

Our Moran Minuteman team will also be out and about serving at community events and in disaster relief efforts. Look for us, and we’ll toss you a t-shirt!
---
| [Nominate a Minuteman!](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=67e97d1b54&e=bbce4dd6ad "Nominate a Minuteman!")
---
|
---
|
## Delivering on Promises
When I campaigned for this position, I promised to defend liberty and stop government overreach. As your Congressman, I am working hard to deliver on that promise.

The current administration is out of control, attempting to use the government bureaucracy to dictate what kind of stoves we can have in our own homes. Take a listen to this KTBB soundbite to learn how freedom-loving members of Congress are working to stop these over-burdensome regulations.
---
| [ ](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=8c03da50b1&e=bbce4dd6ad)
---
| I am incredibly grateful to have the opportunity to go to work every day to protect and defend the freedoms we hold dear. Thank you for trusting me with this honor.
---
| Sincerely,
---
|
---
| Nathaniel Moran Congressman, First District of Texas

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** June 22, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com)

**Tell It Like It Is PAC Releases New Web Video: “Golf Shirts”
** _Ad Targeted At Audiences In Washington D.C. & New Hampshire_
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Today, Tell It Like It Is PAC launched a web video featuring Governor Chris Christie’s sharp criticism of former president Donald Trump and his implausible defense related to his mounting legal woes. Entitled “Golf Shirts,” the :60 second spot will air across digital platforms, specifically targeted to voters in New Hampshire and at this week's Road To Majority Conference in Washington D.C.
The web video features Christie unpacking Trump’s excuse for failing to respond to a federal subpoena, zeroing in on the statement from the former president that, “before I send boxes over, I have to take all of my things out. These boxes were interspersed with all sorts of things: golf shirts, clothing, pants, shoes.”
The Governor concludes by noting, “The problem for Donald Trump with all of this is his own conduct. He’s his own worst enemy.”
“After little more than two weeks as a candidate, it’s clear Governor Christie’s message is resonating,” said **Colin Reed, senior adviser to Tell It Like It Is**. “His relentless media tour and public prosecution of the former president is already moving the needle.”
Over the last week, multiple public polls in New Hampshire have shown Governor Christie surging. A [New Hampshire Journal](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=042c9be9cf&e=d0a9afa930)/coefficient poll put Christie in third place, just 4 points behind Governor DeSantis, and ahead of former Vice President Mike Pence, Governor Nikki Haley, and Senator Tim Scott. Similarly, a [National Research Inc.](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=17801272b9&e=d0a9afa930) survey put Christie’s support at 7 percent.

This is Congressman James Comer. When my Republican colleagues and I asked for your vote last fall, we made a Commitment to America of exactly what we would get done for you if entrusted with the majority.

Now, as Chairman of the House Oversight Committee, I am spearheading our commitment to hold Joe Biden and his cronies accountable to you, and let me tell you - the Biden family corruption our investigations have uncovered in just a few short months is _**damning.**_

**But here 's the thing:**

When the Clintons went after Trump...
When Adam Schiff and Nancy Pelosi went after Trump...
When Merrick Garland and the FBI went after Trump...

name: Courier Newsroom
subject: About Brandolini’s law
body:
AKA the bullsh*t asymmetry principle
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1144%2E120351%2EP6_cM2)
Hey Peter —
**With Tucker Carlson’s return and Trump’s indictment taking up tons of mainstream media airtime, our team has been talking a lot about the “bullsh*t asymmetry principle.”**
[**Before we dive into the bullsh*t, can you make a quick $5 contribution? A $5 donation can pack a powerful punch toward today’s $5,500 fundraising goal and stopping the spread of bad information.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230622?refcode=em20230622&refcode2=1144_120351_P6_cM2&akid=1144%2E120351%2EP6_cM2)
**[Chip in $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230622?refcode=em20230622&refcode2=1144_120351_P6_cM2&akid=1144%2E120351%2EP6_cM2)**
**Brandolini's law, also known as the bullsh*t asymmetry principle** , refers to the huge amount of effort needed to debunk misinformation, in comparison to how easy it is to spread it in the first place.
**Consider this:** it takes seconds to tweet, minutes to record and upload a video, and mere hours for something to go viral — especially if you’re spreading clickbait designed to enrage and manipulate people.
But it takes days, months, or even years of effort — and tons of money and resources — to debunk this misinformation. Just think about how many people **_still_** believe Trump won the 2020 election.
Our newsrooms are at the forefront of this fight, correcting misinformation around elections and our democracy in the same online spaces where it spreads. At times it can be an uphill battle, but your support makes their work possible, Peter.
[**Will you make an $5 contribution today and help our eight local newsrooms fight back against bad information?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230622?refcode=em20230622&refcode2=1144_120351_P6_cM2&akid=1144%2E120351%2EP6_cM2)
**[Chip in $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230622?refcode=em20230622&refcode2=1144_120351_P6_cM2&akid=1144%2E120351%2EP6_cM2)**
Our commitment to meeting misinformation where it’s at and countering it with reliable, accurate stories will continue to be a critical initiative in support of our democracy — especially as the 2024 election season heats up.
Thank you for your support,
The Courier Newsroom Team
**[DONATE »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-footer?refcode=em-footer&t=2&refcode2=1144_120351_P6_cM2&akid=1144%2E120351%2EP6_cM2)**
Email us: [**info@couriernewsroom.com**](mailto:info@couriernewsroom.com)

Vivek is a first-generation American.
