Folks,
Last night, Kevin McCarthy took up the resolution attacking me for holding Trump accountable.
After Trump threatened a primary challenge against any Republican who refused to vote for it, MAGA Republicans officially passed their resolution to censure me. Why? Because I upheld my oath of office and held Donald Trump accountable for his many abuses of power.
They will never silence me — not now and not ever — but I need your help to fight back. If you can, split an urgent $10 contribution to Seth Moulton and our campaign right now to help us respond to this unprecedented political attack. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
We face many pressing challenges as a country — affordable housing, access to health care, creating jobs, and so much more. Instead of addressing any of these challenges, Kevin McCarthy chose to take up this MAGA effort to distract from Donald Trump’s legal problems. They will never stop doing his bidding.
We've already known that the GOP is completely unhinged and beholden to Donald Trump.
With his call now to imprison me and primary any Republican who didn’t vote to censure me, Trump is telling the entire Republican Party that they must seek retribution against me politically and do whatever they can to prevent me from being elected to the Senate. This is not just a political stunt to rile up the MAGA base — it’s an attack on all accountability and constitutional oversight.
But make no mistake: If they thought this was going to deter me from holding Trump and his accomplices accountable or delivering real results for California and our nation, they thought wrong. I will not stop my fight to put truth and our democracy first — even if it means standing up to a twice-impeached ex-president and his lackeys.
With Kevin McCarthy and MAGA Republicans ramping up their attacks against me, I’m going to need you by my side more than ever. Will you split a grassroots donation of $10 to help Seth Moulton and me stand up to the GOP’s attacks? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
MAGA Republicans may have voted to censure me, but I will always use my voice to hold them accountable. No matter what political retribution they throw at me next.
Let’s work together to push back against these attacks on our democracy.
Thank you,
— Adam

With our new Democratic trifecta, we’ve repealed Michigan’s archaic abortion ban, expanded protections for the LGBTQ+ community, lowered costs for families, protected union rights, and so much more. And there’s even more we’re going to accomplish. This just goes to show what is possible when Democrats win critical state legislative races, but we need to keep it up. That’s why I’m asking you to do everything you can to help me elect Democrats this cycle. We need all hands on deck. Last year, before Democrats won control of our government here in Michigan, Republicans derailed my people-first agenda at every turn. The GOP had no interest in protecting freedoms or improving the lives of their constituents. Instead, they voted to strip my powers during the COVID-19 emergency, tried to recall me from office, and gerrymandered our electoral maps to keep themselves in power. I previously served as the Democratic Minority Leader of the Michigan Senate, so I’ve seen firsthand just how much happens in our statehouses – and how important it is to elect strong Democratic leaders and expand our majorities in states like Michigan. Real change is possible, but it requires grassroots Democrats in your state and across the country to be a part of our movement. body:
Access to higher education has more to do with your zip code than your grades or goals. | |
---
Peter, Access to higher education has more to do with your zip code than your grades or goals. Today in the U.S., 43 million people are trapped under the burden of student loans, further entrenching systemic racism and the cycle of poverty. **Student loans widen the racial wealth gap and disproportionately harm Black women.** **We shouldn’t be punishing people for seeking higher education.** We should be rethinking education in the U.S., ensuring access to everyone -- no matter your race, gender, zip code, or income. That’s why Congresswoman Cori Bush is an original co-sponsor of the _College for All Act_. **This critical bill, introduced by Rep. Pramila Jayapal and Sen. Bernie Sanders, would:**
* Provide free tuition at public colleges and universities for families with incomes under $125,000 a year
* Double the maximum Pell Grant amount
* Invest in historically Black colleges and universities, as well as other schools serving marginalized communities

To cover these investments, the _College for All Act_ is fully funded by taxing reckless Wall Street speculation. [**Add your name now to become a grassroots co-sponsor of the _College for All Act_. naked act of political retribution and for their cowardice in bending to
Trump’s threat of a primary challenge to any Republican who opposed my
censure.

enemies I have made.” I have been called a liar by the architects of the

Capitol.

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

God bless, Mark Walker | Meet Mark Walker Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan. In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game. Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. A much-needed innovation
| | | | | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/3139?t=2&akid=13436%2E53494%2EUYbnrf)

| | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4623?t=3&akid=13436%2E53494%2EUYbnrf)
---
Friend, Everyone should be able to benefit from and support the transition to a clean energy future. Direct pay, one of the key innovations in the Inflation Reduction Act, expands access to tax credits beyond private businesses, so that nonprofits, local governments, Tribes, agencies, U.S. territories, and rural co-ops are not left out. **This will help accelerate the transition to clean energy and give communities greater control over their energy resources.** Come learn more about direct pay during an event we're hosting with the Center for Public Enterprise. **[Join us for "Direct Pay Explained"](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4623?t=4&akid=13436%2E53494%2EUYbnrf)** **[on Wednesday, June 28 at 3 PM ET.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4623?t=5&akid=13436%2E53494%2EUYbnrf)**
---
[**RSVP NOW**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4623?t=7&akid=13436%2E53494%2EUYbnrf)
---
You'll hear from me and experts from the Center for Public Enterprise, as well as from Executive Director Will Toor of the Colorado Energy Office. We'll explain how direct pay can be used by your community, government, or organization to benefit the climate and the economy and take your questions. I hope to see you there! Sincerely, Rachel PattersonDeputy Director of Policy Evergreen Collaborative

Dear Peter, As a mom and former English teacher, I know how to spot a bully. I also know how frustrating it can be to feel like no one sees you or accepts you. So when I see Congressman Bergman taking time out of his day to vote against things like marriage equality, I can’t help but wonder: _Don’t you have _anything_ better to do?_ Some politicians spend all of their time trying to interfere in people’s lives instead of helping to improve them. We all deserve (and are promised) equal protection under the law. **Recognizing the dignity of others does nothing to diminish our own.** It’s really that simple. **I’d rather solve problems, not create them.** Right now, we need to support the working class, tackle rising prices, and fight against politicians undermining the democracy my husband put his life on the line to defend. We can either have a representative who spends time trying to dismantle civil liberties and create culture wars, or someone who’s willing to roll up her sleeves and make life better for all Michiganders. I know which type of leader I’d rather be. Let’s do this! Callie Barr

body:
We need a real leader to take on this problem...

| | | | | [](https://sptr.eomail6.com/f/a/X78qeiDqXz-kYKv--xWzKg~~/AAAHUQA~-8~)

| | Friend,
Our nation's debt has reached critical levels, and it's time to address the most urgent issue facing our country head-on. As concerned citizens, we cannot stand idly by while our financial future hangs in the balance. It's time to take action, and I am reaching out to you today because I know we can make a difference together.
The numbers speak for themselves. Under Trump, our debt skyrocketed by a staggering $8 trillion, despite his promises to balance the budget. Regrettably, Biden has continued down this unsustainable path, with $6.2 trillion spent in 2022 alone. **The magnitude of this problem cannot be overstated.**
Allow me to share a personal story that exemplifies the responsible approach we must adopt. During my tenure as Governor of Arkansas, we balanced our budget every year, ensuring stability and prosperity for our state. In 2022, we even achieved a robust budget surplus, a testament to the effectiveness of disciplined fiscal policies.
Now, we face a critical choice. We can choose to act decisively and make the necessary cuts to our spending, even though it may be challenging in the short term. Alternatively, we can delay action, allowing the debt to grow until it becomes an insurmountable burden for future generations.
**I stand before you today as the only candidate running for President who possesses the experience, determination, and proven track record to tackle our nation's debt crisis.** With your generous support, we can work towards a balanced budget and secure a brighter future for all Americans.
[**_I invite you to join our cause by making a donation of $25, $50, or $100 to our campaign_**](https://sptr.eomail6.com/f/a/X78qeiDqXz-kYKv--xWzKg~~/AAAHUQA~-8~)**. **Your contribution will enable us to reach more people, spread our message, and advocate for responsible spending and fiscal accountability.

Last night, Governor Chris Christie returned to New Hampshire.

In his first appearance in the Live Free or Die state since kicking off his presidential campaign, Christie took questions directly from the voters.

Take a look at some of the highlights:
**“I’ll Never Trust A Communist”**

Team, earlier this month we celebrated the Supreme Court’s decision in _Allen v. Milligan_ , which upheld Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act and reaffirmed that map drawers cannot manipulate maps to dilute the voting power of communities of color. **_AP:_
Supreme Court voting rights ruling stuns minority voters, who hope it expands their representation** Because of the Court’s decision, Alabama will have to draw new, fair maps before the next election. As Attorney General Eric Holder said, **“This is a victory for all Americans, and it is an important step toward equal voting power and representation for voters of color across the country.”** | [Help fight for fairness: Donate to the NDRC](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65242849/412786982/866594094?amount=30&refcode=EM_RTI_20230622_FR_6Z_redlight922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlNGEzMTc2LTM5MTEtZWUxMS05MDdjLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=PrsyaiopP-OVbrYGaNp_pROHsmGsHvBC1XJAlsEbkUs=)

Still, our work is far from complete. While the ruling gives our movement the opportunity to advocate for new, fair districts across the country before the 2024 election, Republicans are going to be fighting _tooth and nail_ to protect as many of their gerrymanders as possible.

So now, we have two options.

**Option 1: We can do nothing.** We can hope that the fair maps victories we’ve won will be enough to secure a level playing field in 2024. Meanwhile, Republicans will take our inaction as an opportunity to press their advantage in any way they can.

**Option 2: We can seize this momentum and keep on fighting!** We can resolve to do whatever it takes to protect fair maps victories, prevent Republican gerrymandering, and propel fair redistricting. **Together, we can make sure Democrats have their best shot at a fair fight in 2024.**
**We’re going to take Option 2 and keep on fighting, team. If you’re with us, then make a donation now to power our work:**

name: Lucas Kunce
subject: An important personal update, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY UNITED RURAL DEMOCRATS
body:
United Rural Democrats [https://can2-prod.s3.amazonaws.com/uploads/data/000/670/558/original/logo.png]
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce reaching out with an important personal update.

On Monday, June 5, at 9:47AM, my wife Marilyn delivered our newborn son, Harvey.

7 weeks early. 3.3 lbs. An emergency c-section. I didn’t think I could be more amazed by Marilyn’s resilience — she started working as a kid to help her family survive, came to a new country for opportunity with no money and no friends, and became a successful professional at an environmental non-profit — but witnessing her strength, love, and fortitude during Harvey’s first couple of days in the NICU and her recovery has been incredible.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/105722/images/Screen%20Shot%202023-06-22%20at%2012.06.05%20PM.png]

Marilyn is recovering faster than expected and, for the most part, Harvey is doing well. He still has some time to spend in the NICU, but he is proving to be just as feisty as his mom and getting stronger every day

Everything that happened this month has reminded me more than ever that the campaign we’re building here in Missouri isn’t about personal ambition or getting into office — it’s about making sure families like yours and mine are ok.

It’s about making sure we have a health care system where mothers — especially women of color like Marilyn — in Missouri, a state with one of the highest maternal mortality rates in the country, are safe in childbirth.

It’s about making sure people like me and you can have kids and afford to provide for our families afterwards without getting burdened by medical bills — like the ones that forced my own family into bankruptcy growing up.

And it’s about fighting for a Missouri where we can raise our children to live and thrive for generations with strong communities, opportunities, and good pay.

So yes, I’m running for U.S. Senate. But for my family, I still need to be the most attentive father and husband I can be — especially during this time.

That’s why I’m asking for your help, Peter.

Over the next few weeks, I won’t be able to make as many calls as I usually would to raise our campaign money during this end-of-quarter push — and there’s a real chance that if we don’t make up for it in online donations, our total fundraising number could take a serious hit.

I'm asking you to help me now so that I'm not in a position where I have to choose between spending time with Marilyn and Harvey when they need me and raising the resources to defeat Josh Hawley for all of us. With your help, we can do both.

Supporters like you have always had my back — and now I’m counting on you to be there for me again. So please, will you help my campaign stay on track while I take some time to be a father by splitting a donation of $5, $10, or whatever you can afford between my campaign and United Rural Democrats today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/urdkunce?refcode=230622_lk_splitsend_l1&refcode2=6cba8add-3911-ee11-907c-00224832eb73]

DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/urdkunce?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=230622_lk_splitsend_b1&refcode2=6cba8add-3911-ee11-907c-00224832eb73]

Josh Hawley hasn’t done a thing to make Missouri better for parents and our children — from refusing to raise wages so we can take care of our families to voting against health care to even using his own position and power to control the lives of everyday people all across our state.

These issues are personal to me, just like they are to you. And I’m proud to be fighting for all of us in this race for U.S. Senate.

Thank you so much for having my back, Peter.

Talk soon,
Lucas

If we're going to take back our country, we need a 50-state strategy to organize in every community across the country. body:
Peter,

Nearly a year ago, the Supreme Court took a giant step backwards for civil rights when it overturned Roe v. Wade, decimating women’s access to abortion. And denying a woman the right to make her own personal reproductive decisions is a step in the wrong direction when an overwhelming majority of Americans want their medical decisions to be between themselves and their doctors.

The effect on maternal health has been immediate. The United States is already grappling with the highest maternal death rate among developed nations. Reproductive healthcare restrictions disproportionately affect women of color, particularly in the southern US. And Georgia’s extremist Republicans have wasted no time even further restricting a woman’s access to an abortion, even in life-threatening circumstances.

We don’t have to stay on this path: we can fight back.

Georgia House Democrats believe that Georgians have a right to privacy, and that legislators are not equipped to mandate health care decisions. It’s imperative that we recruit candidates who share those priorities, and who can help overturn the horrific legislation passed by radical Republicans that is damaging our state.

subject: Did you hear about today’s HUGE victory for the gun safety movement?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Thank you. Progress like this wouldn’t be possible without you.
#

Team - this is a HUGE victory!
Today, the US Senate voted to stop the repeal of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives’ rule regulating stabilizing braces.
Stabilizing braces when used with semi-automatic pistols are extremely dangerous because they essentially enable shooters to use the brace as a shoulder stock, creating a short-barrelled rifle. This means shooters can use the braces to create a firearm that is more accurate when firing multiple rounds, as well as more concealable and maneuverable when perpetrating a mass shooting. These weapons pose grave risks to the public and law enforcement.
We’re proud of the 50 Senators that acted with courage and stood up to the gun lobby. The repeal of the ATF’s rule to regulate stabilizing braces would have been a detriment to public safety across our nation.
Today’s vote makes it clear: When we use our collective voices, the gun lobby can’t drown us out. And it proves why elections are so crucial--if we’d lost even one senator, we would have lost the vote.

body:
We’re ready to stand with UPS workers as they negotiate with executives and prepare for a possible strike. To let them know you’re with them too, sign the petition now. | | | Peter, This August, we may be in for the largest work stoppage since 19591 — and the biggest against a single employer in U.S. history.2 **UPS employees in the Teamsters union voted overwhelmingly last week to approve a strike if they don’t reach a contract agreement by July 31, with 97% voting in favor.** These workers allow our economy to function, with an estimated 6% of the national GDP moving in UPS trucks every day.3 **But still, the $150 billion corporation 4 has refused to treat their workers with dignity, including:**
* Using a lower “tier” of pay for certain workers doing the same job,1
* Forcing drivers to work in 120-degree conditions that have killed at least one employee, and
* Implementing constant surveillance in delivery trucks that yells at drivers for drinking water.5

**[If you stand in solidarity with UPS workers as they demand fair treatment from greedy executives, sign the petition now. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EMILY BUSCH FOR CONGRESS
body:
We all hear about school shootings, but I guess I never imagined my school would be next. We’ve been doing active shooter drills at school since X grade but I never really thought I’d put it to use. | | | [](http://links.emilyformichigan.com/u/click?_t=e92c5e294c1440b880a7ffdf88c24a48&_m=b5566531b7cb407a92bb5f201293e77c&_e=syptrxR3qO0-_Ng_M0AfgSDqon4pwdPMZTiCQDydCEkU0JAqwfUe0RAZ7s9ZAZTzFSfSpdvl3zoPiUKxkVL8HndozWAbm3-ivjr_pyX6INec8eR_MBv0FhVcA1xKCmPQf1rpMnPw-m_-6JSCCISMG1w2AUDLqhR7PqaCL5sLZbeF28Onw5wlQhBYUlSHluaUS0sI3vS8Gmimv4L3gQSM1ENuczsKBA9JgrticVhQkFdFTdovxbeHvMwYwXbe-UOAiRwIuqHhMDHGLkO-z6Dtk7hVdRF6qsKCBHehNQehm9JTejrT2Myu0dsicD6ArSzbcXifWnErrI4yVC9WzBvFM5OVUnfluXBrTcJ6WPmdyWsTm9RKeueFdnkhL3k4cZnw8lnd3wHs6jsMvCFM3QDhCkFqbUh3IChJYInrMn2LLKs%3D) We all hear about school shootings, but I guess I never imagined my school would be next. We’ve been doing active shooter drills at school since elementary school, but I never really thought I’d put it to use.But on November 30, 2021, it happened. I was in music class at Oxford High School when a 15-year-old schoolmate opened fire in the hallway. A warning came over the PA system, but no one really knew what was happening. But I was sitting next to a friend who got a text message right then, and I knew from the look on her face that it was an active shooter. My teacher hid us in an empty classroom, then rushed us out a back door and to the Meijer parking lot, where we were safe.**I was one of the lucky ones that day.** Ten students and a teacher were shot. Peter,

Earlier this month, we asked for support from both you and members of
Congress for the Defending the Human Rights of Palestinian Children and
Families Living Under Israeli Military Occupation Act.

This bill would ensure that no U.S. military funding is used to imprison
Palestinian children in the Israeli military detention and court system,
demolish Palestinian homes, or to further expand settlements and annex
Palestinian land.

We need more Justice Democrats in Congress who will fight for legislation
like this and stand up for Palestinian human rights.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135247?refcode=em20230622-29554&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=29554%2E1203867%2ErlV811 ]Peter, will
you contribute $3 right now to help us recruit and elect
more leaders who will fight for Palestinian human rights?

hastening plans to expand settlements in the occupied West Bank.

The time to take action is now. We need widespread support to show members
of Congress that we're expecting them to do the right thing. And we need
your support to recruit and elect more leaders who will be a voice for
Palestinian human rights.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135247?refcode=em20230622-29554&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=29554%2E1203867%2ErlV811 ]Can you chip in $3 to tell our members of Congress that

Thank you for your support,

Team JD

* * *
Peter, folks often ask me about my personal journey and the decision to run for governor. It’s been one exciting ride so far, so I wanted to share a few memories that defined it all:

July 2, 2001

The day I took the oath of office as the 23-year-old mayor of Nettleton. Green as a gourd, I was excited to get to work. I can’t thank the people of my hometown enough for placing their trust in me all those years ago.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65246236/412798834/1420088401?refcode=ea.c373c3ef-4311-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ms=ea.c373c3ef-4311-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzMTAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzM3M2MzZWYtNDMxMS1lZTExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xhFmdsvJ-c3LbR1jdX5Tq0hBDLemFEyiyClzD9sKEGM=)
November 7, 2007

At the young age of 30, I became the youngest Public Service Commissioner ever elected in Mississippi history. And I made things happen. I’ve opened up meetings that had been closed to the public for decades, brought high-speed internet to some of the most remote parts of Mississippi, put people back to work, and saved taxpayers over 6 billion dollars.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65246239/412798837/1420088401?refcode=ea.c373c3ef-4311-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ms=ea.c373c3ef-4311-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzMTAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzM3M2MzZWYtNDMxMS1lZTExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xhFmdsvJ-c3LbR1jdX5Tq0hBDLemFEyiyClzD9sKEGM=)
January 12, 2023

The day I launched my campaign for governor in Mississippi. I couldn’t be more grateful to have overwhelming support from voters and local community members across our great state. On day one, it was clear to me that we could build a movement strong enough to move Mississippi forward.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65246242/412798840/1420088401?refcode=ea.c373c3ef-4311-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ms=ea.c373c3ef-4311-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzMTAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzM3M2MzZWYtNDMxMS1lZTExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xhFmdsvJ-c3LbR1jdX5Tq0hBDLemFEyiyClzD9sKEGM=)
November 7, 2023

Nearly four months from now, Mississippi will face the most competitive Election Day in decades. And it’s one of the toughest challenges I have yet to face. It’s not easy to take on a well-funded, bought-and-paid-for politician like Tate Reeves. But I believe our campaign, powered by everyday people like you, can get the job done and move Mississippi forward.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65246245/412798843/1420088401?refcode=ea.c373c3ef-4311-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ms=ea.c373c3ef-4311-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzMTAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzM3M2MzZWYtNDMxMS1lZTExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xhFmdsvJ-c3LbR1jdX5Tq0hBDLemFEyiyClzD9sKEGM=)

clean_body: Here are a few moments I will never forget. | = | = Peter, folks often ask me about my personal journey and the decision to run for governor. It’s been one exciting ride so far, so I wanted to share a few memories that defined it all: July 2, 2001 The day I took the oath of office as the 23-year-old mayor of Nettleton. Green as a gourd, I was excited to get to work. I can’t thank the people of my hometown enough for placing their trust in me all those years ago. = November 7, 2007 At the young age of 30, I became the youngest Public Service Commissioner ever elected in Mississippi history. And I made things happen. I’ve opened up meetings that had been closed to the public for decades, brought high-speed internet to some of the most remote parts of Mississippi, put people back to work, and saved taxpayers over 6 billion dollars. = January 12, 2023 The day I launched my campaign for governor in Mississippi. I couldn’t be more grateful to have overwhelming support from voters and local community members across our great state. On day one, it was clear to me that we could build a movement strong enough to move Mississippi forward. = November 7, 2023 Nearly four months from now, Mississippi will face the most competitive Election Day in decades. And it’s one of the toughest challenges I have yet to face. It’s not easy to take on a well-funded, bought-and-paid-for politician like Tate Reeves. But I believe our campaign, powered by everyday people like you, can get the job done and move Mississippi forward. = = = | = | = ---|---|--- = | = | = Thanks for your support, Brandon Presley = | | = = Follow along:** Paid for by Brandon Presley Campaign Brandon Presley Campaign P.O. body:
we just ran out of money

Hello, When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert last year, we were the underdogs until the very end. Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies. Ultimately, though, Adam lost to Lauren Boebert in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country. The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money. In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we knew we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions. Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book. It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he’s running again against Lauren Boebert. We need to make sure that we have the time and the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024. Adam can win. But Boebert’s allies are already attacking him, and Adam’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to defeat Lauren Boebert, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now: **[This was the closest race in the country in 2022. It could be even closer in 2024. Please, will you split $10 or more right now between Adam’s campaign and Brittany Pettersen's – any amount you can afford will go a long way – and make sure we have the resources to finally defeat Lauren Boebert?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65246272/412798959/-665207148?refcode=email_062223_frisch-pettersen-split&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNDYxYzMzMi00NDExLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aNW1SZFaOF2rhpuq6GYbwmvrjJl1YVjGSCl9Fwp8ObU=)** From our entire family, thank you. body:

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=81f5e829a186475bbd3f4b86753a57f3&_e=abw3iDQqLmLDLgR-yRIy6fprxmU5JKqF9ZMeuE6spri5BVUJfT9FXlcZ8o6cwmrXk273EHr_t_dFnUw9-bYtPTCzpahqFNB8kFvxa5tGkDA7ZqElTBderkNdfMiAOedPinbH5vrt25f1ZfafjYoJcDpIlpi39vDqnZSxQGx0HaRykwEFJP3ptr4MwlirH3SovHWOMJU_YL1J07OKAo1yRDMb6wB5X8MqugQp5qEsxm2CWK4jHFQb_n_flZbkIZ2-yjiNPE5T1aP-qFKSZSWAnWts3FBrj-756gamYI_6oCgLsKiiEze5lEv9bmld-N_pA3FWaFNlJNquGIlZTyoDwH5OFWywT3C8yeg9ivhjEqrsw1rCTUR3ao8e031iac1j3KrUqtgoQ4Nqyg8D1NsztPUhv5-TyOsOidgDcEhrlWY%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=81f5e829a186475bbd3f4b86753a57f3&_e=abw3iDQqLmLDLgR-yRIy6fprxmU5JKqF9ZMeuE6spri5BVUJfT9FXlcZ8o6cwmrXk273EHr_t_dFnUw9-bYtPTCzpahqFNB8kFvxa5tGkDA7ZqElTBderkNdfMiAOedPinbH5vrt25f1ZfafjYoJcDpIlpi39vDqnZSxQGx0HaRykwEFJP3ptr4MwlirH3SovHWOMJU_YL1J07OKAo1yRDMb6wB5X8MqugQp5qEsxm2CWK4jHFQb_n_flZbkIZ2-yjiNPE5T1aP-qFKSZSWAnfGArlnErSexw94HFrc1zP_-eMtmYCl7ALtkuiPRSFdN5-iX4E65BQ4ANA8uUD3hYaGuSLfaWgQCmL1sd0paCrkIj6pQn8M5OlMdsIfZ_s8xPcoqxaP4YfxfHYYHsxFl6jRO1-E-Rz-gXYOsT-0RVAQ%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=81f5e829a186475bbd3f4b86753a57f3&_e=abw3iDQqLmLDLgR-yRIy6fprxmU5JKqF9ZMeuE6spri5BVUJfT9FXlcZ8o6cwmrXk273EHr_t_dFnUw9-bYtPTCzpahqFNB8kFvxa5tGkDA7ZqElTBderkNdfMiAOedPinbH5vrt25f1ZfafjYoJcDpIlpi39vDqnZSxQGx0HaRykwEFJP3ptr4MwlirH3SovHWOMJU_YL1J07OKAo1yRDMb6wB5X8MqugQp5qEsxm2CWK4jHFQb_n_flZbkIZ2-yjiNPE5T1aP-qFKSZSWAnZcHFnDHX8aGjXbq3n-dVBTQ1_8D5m7zDvcs6ONGMJKNGcbZbXLptCrlfgngZnjbs_JkAg9-PPTZIXEhy-Au1xVPvwmFZ9msZLCbs9e_tJa52ETazKmXAi-0sDhOnJplbKKTFEvWEP41BO8IKJjAQp8%3D)**

subject: Paving the way for an America we deserve
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
A better America is possible and achievable.
#
Peter,
One thing is for certain, America needs work.
Every day, poor and working families across the country struggle to make ends meet. And in return they see far too many corrupt elected officials and judges ignore desperate calls for change and action. **This inaction is untenable.**
Pramila knows the challenges faced by folks across the county, and she knows these crises demand bold, immediate action. That is why she has led the fight to guarantee health care for all, address the student debt crisis, and demand Supreme Court Justices are held to strict ethical standards.
**Pramilia is proving a better America is possible.**[**But her work does not stop there and neither does ours. If you are able to, will you chip in $3 towards a more progressive society?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42529?source=em20230622-2630&t=1&akid=2630%2E420207%2ElB4jF-)
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42529?refcode=em20230622-2630&t=20&akid=2630%2E420207%2ElB4jF-)**
In the past month, we've learned that the extreme right-wing majority on the Supreme Court will not only strip away people's fundamental rights, but also engage in blatant corruption. Report after report details Justice Clarence Thomas's close ties to GOP billionaire mega-donor Harlan Crow. And just yesterday it was revealed that Justice Samuel Alito was gifted a luxury vacation by a GOP hedge fund billionaire with business in front of the court.
This blatant corruption at the highest levels of our judicial system is one of the reasons why Americans have lost faith in our government.**That's why Pramila introduced the Judicial Ethics Act to finally enforce ethical standards and restore the people's trust in the nation's highest court.**
Pramila is leading the fight in Washington to build a democracy that answers to the people — not a system that is rigged in favor of the rich and powerful. **With supporters like you****, Peter,****we can put a stop to the corruption in our government and be the collective catalyst towards a stronger democracy.**[**Please chip in to power our movement for progressive change today.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42529?source=em20230622-2630&t=21&akid=2630%2E420207%2ElB4jF-)
Together,
Jayapal HQ

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

[](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63eb472f46fa4b92a1cf5ad82de48796&_e=rnEsyVaVWHqPDMRxWPFtR9lpHZw3OIBl7SYNLqn5bylUZjSPSs1_rsaw0s-eAiPHC6gqsmQnyT-X0HcDwjoD1-U2TLgOjOqVpnKjiVIztCNvrn2bCbAB-CVVR6tY2tQIvbeqXb3KDrSiwcNdl0PVncSJxdIBI_EP4ZXiFDtKIAZM040hqzQMCJjLj0a2O026KtWZm_aKZ51d27j1maIDLlEm-z0xxG6sRvy5fv133m2ZDb6ERNd6uV8RfMbobzHdIMAgtHlHAMo9HLBB9X2oWCJJZgZxktAwykuAmgMwMbI%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63eb472f46fa4b92a1cf5ad82de48796&_e=rnEsyVaVWHqPDMRxWPFtR9lpHZw3OIBl7SYNLqn5bylUZjSPSs1_rsaw0s-eAiPHC6gqsmQnyT-X0HcDwjoD1-U2TLgOjOqVpnKjiVIztCNvrn2bCbAB-CVVR6tY2tQIvbeqXb3KDrSiwcNdl0PVnXgNrO5iPwhSvJ1PwaTjKRRrc_xSAVOJJqMyhiQX2ak706nieexT_3i_R-WcXj9Q_a5Otec3OGbjZqifO5Inn3ARkR4xvsf4pEmfhgMOPxxovxzWYvzmYCVap0xLFSdBor7_p7BkifXk7sHIv0Mc7bU%3D)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63eb472f46fa4b92a1cf5ad82de48796&_e=rnEsyVaVWHqPDMRxWPFtR9lpHZw3OIBl7SYNLqn5bylUZjSPSs1_rsaw0s-eAiPHC6gqsmQnyT-X0HcDwjoD1-U2TLgOjOqVpnKjiVIztCNvrn2bCbAB-CVVR6tY2tQIvbeqXb3KDrSiwcNdl0PVneh6_HVEidmyhyY5KKD7rBqGqJZSQPeqjmZgMzj3bpeZs75mOV6S2vSShDxblmk7i8moyVydf7K9r9cH4jU2PR7xR1Z1rDcRIYi4lG9J9JrNPGXhHUqwa4o3-Cem4KNLcf0Qo-nU5UUSp9Ef80c3kQ8%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63eb472f46fa4b92a1cf5ad82de48796&_e=rnEsyVaVWHqPDMRxWPFtR9lpHZw3OIBl7SYNLqn5bylUZjSPSs1_rsaw0s-eAiPHC6gqsmQnyT-X0HcDwjoD1-U2TLgOjOqVpnKjiVIztCNvrn2bCbAB-CVVR6tY2tQIvbeqXb3KDrSiwcNdl0PVnTnbtyz9qZK5T_eqUQbPjS4O_kDkrRjmOBcJs_xPJdIAaImPb2W36TOsf4rCOwmD4liKEk2-ycXXEorEqMbJ8kCm54BH6pP0KXqclktGiIZYoJaHEHjo_bWqT7wpVGkec3VmmOTyb4XMGeCAkassNd8%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63eb472f46fa4b92a1cf5ad82de48796&_e=rnEsyVaVWHqPDMRxWPFtR9lpHZw3OIBl7SYNLqn5bylUZjSPSs1_rsaw0s-eAiPHC6gqsmQnyT-X0HcDwjoD1-U2TLgOjOqVpnKjiVIztCNvrn2bCbAB-CVVR6tY2tQIvbeqXb3KDrSiwcNdl0PVnRyQfCXY1Ms_7H7Vx_4BxJFUkBXUCRge1taQWU-jtGqW5Dr7Hyvy1X3BGakKdr2Gi-Luvkbr4vjTR2jcZWsr9pc4IeN9fx-whPzFPvwwAiyQQWVIFOcisFF8R2RIRZF7srIlVHOjkbF4yfQSyX3nJ0g%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyMkT2PnDAQhn-N6UD-AAMFxSoEKcVGqzQpLWMG1pE_0NjktP_-hG5362tnnnk0M-_fq7pq62zYfmsPA3qFSQWttLElgrObjUdSnHJRUllyrkSxDLLnbccKGJjs2rqTnaDFfTBrz2ZZ9-tSt03D6nmBXtJe0nnpNei5sMPpoZJzzlkrmqo1lDLWNA3oWYquJTVF2I_ZWaOD1_8i2vyoAuTCDfec90TEhfCJ8CmuK2CqtAc8WRMxAKYcA1QRN8Kn9-6lszNgfpTpwP_wOMfFdGSvjPa7tlsgYnzDT_aFypNL8UADRIw7xrSDyTZsz5aHxR6eiBG8tu5ZNDFkCJmI8XYp_1zL182Eyy-VMnE5fZcfv7ig9c8bpazAYdk_rHM2yfMN2ymsTPRF_k4mnwEAAP__IJ2VMA) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyMkT2PnDAQhn-N6UD-AAMFxSoEKcVGqzQpLWMG1pE_0NjktP_-hG5362tnnnk0M-_fq7pq62zYfmsPA3qFSQWttLElgrObjUdSnHJRUllyrkSxDLLnbccKGJjs2rqTnaDFfTBrz2ZZ9-tSt03D6nmBXtJe0nnpNei5sMPpoZJzzlkrmqo1lDLWNA3oWYquJTVF2I_ZWaOD1_8i2vyoAuTCDfec90TEhfCJ8CmuK2CqtAc8WRMxAKYcA1QRN8Kn9-6lszNgfpTpwP_wOMfFdGSvjPa7tlsgYnzDT_aFypNL8UADRIw7xrSDyTZsz5aHxR6eiBG8tu5ZNDFkCJmI8XYp_1zL182Eyy-VMnE5fZcfv7ig9c8bpazAYdk_rHM2yfMN2ymsTPRF_k4mnwEAAP__IJ2VMA)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://email.republicanmajority.net/c/eJyMkT2PnDAQhn-N6UD-AAMFxSoEKcVGqzQpLWMG1pE_0NjktP_-hG5362tnnnk0M-_fq7pq62zYfmsPA3qFSQWttLElgrObjUdSnHJRUllyrkSxDLLnbccKGJjs2rqTnaDFfTBrz2ZZ9-tSt03D6nmBXtJe0nnpNei5sMPpoZJzzlkrmqo1lDLWNA3oWYquJTVF2I_ZWaOD1_8i2vyoAuTCDfec90TEhfCJ8CmuK2CqtAc8WRMxAKYcA1QRN8Kn9-6lszNgfpTpwP_wOMfFdGSvjPa7tlsgYnzDT_aFypNL8UADRIw7xrSDyTZsz5aHxR6eiBG8tu5ZNDFkCJmI8XYp_1zL182Eyy-VMnE5fZcfv7ig9c8bpazAYdk_rHM2yfMN2ymsTPRF_k4mnwEAAP__IJ2VMA)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

body:
Friends –
Impulsive, emotional decisions are out of character for me.
I am the guy who had a four-year plan to get into Harvard even though my family was dirt poor.
So I thought long and hard about the decision to run for the United States Senate.
I prepared for it long before the possibility of Senator Sinema’s party switch.
I came to the conclusion that as a Marine, a Latino, and someone with a record of standing up for working people, we can build a coalition that can win a 2-way race, 3-way race, 27-way race... doesn’t matter.
The only open question was whether the grassroots support would be there. And I thought it would be. So far, I’ve been right.
So I am asking:

body:
I’m excited to be part of this team to send Lateefah to Congress.
# [](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/39?t=1&akid=49%2E1163%2EekQ0Ti)
Hey, it's Zoë, Lateefah's campaign manager! 👋 With less than a week until the end of the quarter, I wanted to check in and give you a glimpse behind the scenes of what my days look like at this point in the race. **But first, I have a personal request:**
**[We're $9,287 away from hitting our digital fundraising goal. You and I both know we can easily close that gap-- but only if folks like you can contribute now. Can I count on you to contribute whatever you're able to (even $10 will help chip at that figure) before you continue reading?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em20230622-1?refcode=em20230622&refcode2=49_1163_ekQ0Ti&akid=49%2E1163%2EekQ0Ti)**
**[Close the gap »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em20230622-1?refcode=em20230622&refcode2=49_1163_ekQ0Ti&akid=49%2E1163%2EekQ0Ti)**
The first thing I do in the morning is reconcile our campaign budget -- a financial blueprint of our path to victory -- with dollars raised. We're building a locally-rooted, diverse coalition that will ensure _every single voter_ in California's 12th district knows Lateefah and her history of uplifting progressive values. **Above all else, it's my job to ensure that we're able to subsidize our robust operation.**
In fact, if there's one thing I've learned from my years managing campaigns, it's that **_there is no substitute for early money._ We have to make sure we build a solid foundation and have the resources we need _now_ to win.**
**[That's why I'm asking you, again: Can you make a contribution today to fuel our campaign? Every contribution makes the biggest difference to us.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em20230622-1?refcode=em20230622&refcode2=49_1163_ekQ0Ti&akid=49%2E1163%2EekQ0Ti)**
**[Donate $10 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em20230622-1?amount=10&refcode=em20230622&refcode2=49_1163_ekQ0Ti&akid=49%2E1163%2EekQ0Ti)**
I know it seems early in the election cycle, but here's the deal: this time is crucial for campaigns like Lateefah's that rely on grassroots supporters like you -- rather than the mega-donor groups that some of her opponents are expected to turn to.
Lateefah and our team meet daily to identify communities we want to meet with and to keep tabs on what expenditures are necessary to fulfill our path to victory. I know that we can build critical campaign infrastructure, hire staff on the ground, and make investments in grassroots organizing right now with your help -- but it'll only happen with your support.
With your grassroots support, we can out-raise, out-knock, and out-work any of our opponents. **[So if you're with us, I respectfully ask you to do your part by chipping in $10 or more now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em20230622-1?refcode=em20230622&refcode2=49_1163_ekQ0Ti&akid=49%2E1163%2EekQ0Ti)**
Thank you so much for being a part of this team! 💜
With gratitude,

* **I believe in fighting for the underdog.** I have spent my career standing up to the powerful and winning on behalf of people without money, connections, or power.
* **I know how to get big things done.** As the chief public defender in Montgomery and Philadelphia Counties, I oversaw more than 500 people and a budget of $50 million. I instituted real reforms and made a difference in our communities.
* **I was raised in a proud union household.** My dad was a union laborer and my mom was a parole officer. I understand the power of strong unions in fighting on behalf of hardworking families.
* **I want a more balanced system of justice for all.** Public safety is not black or white, blue or red, or police versus the community — it’s all of us working together, paving the way for a safer society.
* **I’m no stranger to firsts.** I was the first in my family to graduate college and the first African American woman to run the nation’s fourth largest public defender’s office. But, Peter, I’m not running for this office because I check a list of ideological boxes. I’m running for this office to protect Pennsylvania families — that means yours.

The founding fathers put the power of oversight in the hands of Congress. They had no way of anticipating a morally bankrupt hypocrite like Congressman Jim Jordan would ever hold the reigns of power through Chairmanship of the Judiciary Committee. So far with everything at his disposal, he has used his power to weaponize our government and hinder the Trump trials.

The Trump administration was fraught with mismanagement, cronyism and investigations due to the general corruption and misconduct of the administration. In the reality of alternative facts, it has been the goal of Republicans to fabricate something equal to that environment as a cynical ploy. Jim Jordan uses his powers within the Committee to forward this project. Even going so far as to put his highly partisan and factually suspect tweets on the front page of the Judiciary Committee’s website. This could make Rupert Murdock blush.

This Congress alone, Jordan has entirely fabricated investigations and hidden the details of those from his Democrat counterparts on the Committee. His ‘Select Committee Against the Weaponization of The Federal Government’ functions like an absolute satire of its own name.

With Jim’s staunch and continued support for Trump we can see what will be in store for investigators once Jordan concocts a plan to defend the indefensible. The investigators can look forward to continued harassment, subpoenas and potentially ways to halt the investigation all together. If tools for obstruction exist, Jordan will no doubt attempt to use them against justice itself.

body:
I didn’t expect the “summer fundraising slump” to start this early.

| Hey Peter, Jon here.

I’ve got to be honest with you, I’m disappointed. My team just let me know that we didn’t reach our fundraising goal. With the public FEC deadline right around the corner, this is bad news.

This team always shows up when I need them most. With your help, a little luck, and some hard work, I know we’ll get back on track in no time.

Peter,

Gun violence is now the leading cause of death for children and teens in this country – an epidemic that has taken a terrible toll on our communities.

**Washington has made great strides in tackling our nation’s gun violence epidemic, and as governor, I’m committed to continuing this legacy.**

Many of my friends own guns — it’s a part of rural life in Washington. But, they also support commonsense laws because they save lives.

**We need leaders who will tackle our biggest problems by bringing us together around our shared values.** I’m committed to doing just that – reaching out, finding common ground, and ensuring our families and communities are not only safe, but also thrive.

Peter:

In 2018, West Virginia Sen. Joe Manchin spent $8.9 million – not including super PAC money – to win another term in the Senate. Sen. Manchin won by 3.3%; **former President Trump would win West Virginia two years later by 39%.**

Sen. Manchin eked out his 2018 win because of the decades of goodwill he’d built up around the state and because he vastly outspent his Republican opponent. Everyone in conservative politics – and on the other side of the aisle, for that matter, thinks they know what Manchin’s next move will be. **Will he run, or won’t he? That’s the $9 million question.**

While Sen. Manchin has not publicly announced his intention to seek a 4th term in the Senate (he’s waiting until December), his allies say it’s “crazy to count him out” at this point.

They’re right. New polling featured two hypothetical matchups – one between Manchin and Rep. Alex Mooney and the other between Manchin and Governor Jim Justice. I want to take a moment to personally thank you for all you’ve done for our campaign so far.

**Peter -- As you likely know, I’m a proud, openly gay man.**

But I'll be honest, navigating that identity hasn’t always been easy.

From discrimination to stigma, bullying and rejection, queer adults and young people face a host of uniquely painful obstacles. **That’s why Pride Month is such an important time for our community and our nation.**

It’s a chance to celebrate, acknowledge, and take pride in our vibrance and resilience.

It’s a time to remember how much Black trans women and queer people of color sacrificed to push our movement forward.

But it’s also a time to reaffirm our commitment to a world without hate, discrimination and inequality.

Sadly, with record numbers of anti-LGBTQ+ bills being introduced around the country, this year’s Pride is more significant than ever. I’m fighting everyday to stop queer and transphobia in Congress **but I need your help.**

[**Peter, this Pride Month, will you join me in recommitting to the fight for LGBTQ+ rights and dignity? I need every Democrat to join me in this fight today. »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65249634/412811412/-914831094?refcode=MTFC_20230622_EMPET_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGM2YjFiZS01MjExLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Dg2YMyylQjy5599XBilKuMjWXjkCSNi_KzG7y5_Fg8Q=&emci=669b7f1a-0d11-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=c8c6b1be-5211-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=18839602) | [SIGN ON TO RECOMMIT TO THE FIGHT FOR LGBTQ+ RIGHTS »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65249635/412811413/-914831094?refcode=MTFC_20230622_EMPET_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGM2YjFiZS01MjExLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Dg2YMyylQjy5599XBilKuMjWXjkCSNi_KzG7y5_Fg8Q=&emci=669b7f1a-0d11-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=c8c6b1be-5211-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=18839602)

clean_body: Peter, I want to wish you a Happy Pride Month! | = Peter -- As you likely know, I’m a proud, openly gay man. But I'll be honest, navigating that identity hasn’t always been easy. From discrimination to stigma, bullying and rejection, queer adults and young people face a host of uniquely painful obstacles. That’s why Pride Month is such an important time for our community and our nation. It’s a chance to celebrate, acknowledge, and take pride in our vibrance and resilience. It’s a time to remember how much Black trans women and queer people of color sacrificed to push our movement forward. But it’s also a time to reaffirm our commitment to a world without hate, discrimination and inequality. Sadly, with record numbers of anti-LGBTQ+ bills being introduced around the country, this year’s Pride is more significant than ever. I’m fighting everyday to stop queer and transphobia in Congress but I need your help. | Peter, this Pride Month take a moment to celebrate all that you are -- even if that means being different. body:
This seems bad.
| What's going on with the Supreme Court?
---|---
There’s been so much news about the Supreme Court’s corruption lately, it’s been hard to keep up.
Just this week, it was revealed that Justice Samuel Alito went on an undisclosed fishing trip to Alaska paid for by billionaire, GOP megadonor Paul Singer — whose hedge fund then argued 10 cases in front of the Supreme Court, winning at least $2.4 billion in the process.
SCOTUS is in a legitimacy crisis.
[This Supreme Court is devolving into a politicized entity known for rank corruption, erosion of democracy, and the unraveling of human rights. Alexandria is demanding the House provide a legislative check to SCOTUS overreach and abuse of power. Will you support Alexandria’s call for accountability by making a $3 contribution today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230622.w38NTj&refcode=em20230622-4513-P_FND_EXP_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4513%2E2526796%2E3wa7AO)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230622.w38NTj&refcode=em20230622-4513-P_FND_EXP_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=4513%2E2526796%2E3wa7AO)**
As the Court’s term for the year draws to a close — and they soon issue pivotal decisions on affirmative action, gerrymandering, and student debt forgiveness — we wanted to take a minute to break down what we know:
* **Justice Clarence Thomas has received luxury gifts nearly every year for decades without reporting them in financial disclosures.** 1 These gifts, paid for by billionaire real estate developer Harlan Crow, include private jet trips around the world, vacations on Crow’s private superyacht, and at least two years of private school tuition for Justice Thomas’ grandnephew.2 Crow also purchased the home of Justice Thomas’ mother. He allowed her to live there rent free, and has spent thousands of dollars on renovations to her home.
* Conservative judicial activist Leonard Leo made **secret payments to Virginia ‘Ginni’ Thomas — wife of Justice Thomas — totalling over $80,000** from 2011 to 2012, specifically directing that her name be left off billing paperwork.
* Supreme Court Justice Neil Gorsuch **sold property in Colorado to the CEO of Greenberg Traurig, one of the country’s biggest law firms.** 3 Justice Gorsuch disclosed income from the purchase, but declined to identify that the CEO of Greenberg Traurig was the purchaser, leaving the box blank on the disclosure form. Since 2017, **Greenberg Traurig has been involved in at least 22 cases before the Supreme Court.**
* **Jane Roberts — wife of Chief Justice John Roberts — solicited $10.3 million in commissions as a legal recruiter in the 8 years after her husband’s Court appointment.** 4 The fees were paid to Roberts by corporations and law firms, at least one of which argued a case before the Supreme Court.

**And when asked to participate in a congressional inquiry into these potentially illegal ethical violations, Chief Justice Roberts and the Court refused to comply.**
A court that rejects accountability for itself erodes its own ability to hold others accountable.
Alexandria called for the impeachment of Clarence Thomas for the most egregious of these violations — and she wants Justices to be held to the same ethical standards of other elected officials to stop this corruption in the future.
[If you can, will you chip in $3 to power her fight?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230622.w38NTj&refcode=em20230622-4513-P_FND_EXP_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=4513%2E2526796%2E3wa7AO)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230622.w38NTj&refcode=em20230622-4513-P_FND_EXP_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=4513%2E2526796%2E3wa7AO)**
We will keep you posted as more on the Supreme Court develops.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

name: John Fetterman
subject: Important work
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
We're focused on getting things done in the Senate.
#
Hey Derek, it's John.
I take this job really, really seriously. It's an honor to have been elected to fight for PA families + do what I can in Washington to *actually* improve people's lives. 🙏
I didn't come to Congress to make headlines -- unlike some of my colleagues on the far right. So while they're fighting over when and how to impeach President Biden (over... nothing?), **we're focused on the important work in the Senate.**
It might not always make the news, but we're doing big things. Like helping PA farmers and local agriculture with the Protecting Mushroom Farmers Act. Freeing up funding for implementing safer street design for pedestrians with the Shovel Ready Streets Act. And confirming diverse, qualified, impressive judges and administration appointees for roles throughout the government that make a difference in people's lives.
**[These are the sorts of priorities I know you gave me your support so I can fight for. If you're able to, consider chipping in any amount so I can keep up this important work in the Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230622-1?refcode=em20230622-1-8422&refcode2=8422_434096_VvkzwK&akid=8422%2E434096%2EVvkzwK)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230622-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230622-8422&refcode2=8422_434096_VvkzwK&akid=8422%2E434096%2EVvkzwK)**
I'm really thankful you're part of this team!!
— John 💛
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator, Pennsylvania

Friend,

If you've ever made an online purchase — maybe for food delivery, clothing, a concert ticket, or a hotel reservation — you might have wondered afterward why the charge was just a little higher than advertised. You're not alone.

**Millions of Americans have been hit with "junk fees" in everyday transactions.** (Junk fees are what we call the additional – and often hidden – charges that a wide range of lenders and vendors apply.)

Earlier this year in his State of the Union address, President Biden highlighted these junk fees as a key area in which government can step up to help consumers. **In the wake of his call to action, we're now seeing major companies like LiveNation and SeatGeek announce that they will reveal _all_ components of ticket costs to would-be purchasers.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65250496/412814083/-1005076792?ms=EM_PET_230622JF_N_TW_FULL_8_G_N_P1&refcode=EM_PET_230622JF_N_TW_FULL_8_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTZlYTc3ZS01NzExLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IY6hSh7wgCrVhp-0cnZ1-w6hXfOHdqREHi5r90VqtRE=&emci=10dc992e-4711-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=f96ea77e-5711-ee11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=32654120) This is incredibly encouraging news, but Jennifer knows that we need to ensure that more companies follow suit — and ideally _lower_ costs. clean_body: Will you help us pass legislation to crack down on corporations who price-gouge consumers without their knowledge? = Friend, If you've ever made an online purchase — maybe for food delivery, clothing, a concert ticket, or a hotel reservation — you might have wondered afterward why the charge was just a little higher than advertised. You're not alone. Millions of Americans have been hit with "junk fees" in everyday transactions. (Junk fees are what we call the additional – and often hidden – charges that a wide range of lenders and vendors apply.) Earlier this year in his State of the Union address, President Biden highlighted these junk fees as a key area in which government can step up to help consumers. In the wake of his call to action, we're now seeing major companies like LiveNation and SeatGeek announce that they will reveal all components of ticket costs to would-be purchasers. This is incredibly encouraging news, but Jennifer knows that we need to ensure that more companies follow suit — and ideally lower costs. The types of transactions that incur junk fees are inescapable in modern life. And for the many Americans struggling with the daily cost of living, the impact of an extra charge here and an extra charge really does add up. We can help millions of people if we put firmer guardrails in place against junk fees. But big special interests are going to fight us tooth and nail. That's why we need as many supporters as possible to make their voices heard and demand that Congress serve the people and not the special interests. Thank you, Team Wexton | Rep.
